sources.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous')), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH MathFallSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), DeptUnitsStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mfs.num_subjects, mfs.TERM_START_DATE, mfs.TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'MathFallSubjects' AS Reason FROM MathFallSubjects AS mfs UNION ALL SELECT dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS num_subjects, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TERM_END_DATE, dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_DESCRIPTION, num_subjects, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION), Subquery1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON icte.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.max_enrollment_range, s1.max_enrollment_variance, s1.max_enrollment_stddev, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.CALENDAR_DATE, s2.DAY_OF_WEEK, s2.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.max_enrollment_range DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units, (inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS overall ON inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = overall.ACADEMIC_YEAR), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON inner_cte2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.dept_avg_total_units, cte1.deviation_from_overall_avg, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, cte2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CombinedGeometricMeans AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'MaterialsPerSubject' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'DegreeYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDegreeYear UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'FinancialAidYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, Reason FROM CombinedGeometricMeans ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH MathDeptStddev AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptStddev2022 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dsd.total_units_stddev AS dept_stddev_2022 FROM MathDeptStddev AS mds LEFT JOIN DeptStddev2022 AS dsd ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS css JOIN MathTermStats AS mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous')), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK, ROUND(s1.window_column / NULLIF(s2.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_RunningSum_to_SubjectRank FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_total_units_3rows, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT total_units_range IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.max_total_units_3rows, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), cte1 AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR), cte2 AS (SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.num_subjects, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.total_units_variance, cte2.total_units_stddev, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.num_subjects DESC, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH math_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.max_total_units_3rows FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.TERM_CODE), eng_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.TERM_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.TERM_CODE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.max_total_units_3rows, e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.TERM_START_DATE, e.TERM_END_DATE, e.window_column FROM math_cte AS m JOIN eng_cte AS e ON m.TERM_CODE = e.TERM_CODE ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.TERM_CODE, e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3), cte1 AS (SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ta.TERM_START_DATE, ta.TERM_END_DATE, ta.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ta ON ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ta.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), cte2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC) SELECT cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.max_record_count_variance, cte2.min_record_count_variance FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, ts.num_reserve_materials FROM TopSubjects AS ts JOIN PreviousTerms AS pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.num_reserve_materials, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

WITH max_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS subq GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_avg_subject_enrollment DESC), term_window_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Terms.Total_Terms_Per_Year, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.TERM_CODE) AS Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 GROUP BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Total_Terms ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT tws.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.TERM_END_DATE, tws.window_column, tws.Total_Terms_Per_Year, mae.max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM term_window_stats AS tws JOIN max_avg_enrollment AS mae ON tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mae.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE

WITH RollupResults AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), YearTermCounts AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0), DeptVariation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_terms, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH iap_activities AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE), previous_terms AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT * FROM inner_cte) SELECT iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_activities.window_column AS IAP_DENSE_RANK, iap_activities.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, previous_terms.TERM_CODE AS PREV_TERM_CODE, previous_terms.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, previous_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, previous_terms.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, previous_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM iap_activities JOIN previous_terms ON iap_activities.TERM_CODE = previous_terms.TERM_CODE ORDER BY iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, previous_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_stats.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS avg_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.deviation_from_min_enrolled_students, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.unique_departments, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.record_count_variance DESC, s2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units) SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH iap_activities AS (SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) AS inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE), previous_terms AS (SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') AS inner_cte) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.window_column AS activity_dense_rank, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS prev_term_description, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column AS running_sum_academic_year, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM iap_activities AS ia JOIN previous_terms AS pt ON ia.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms AS pts JOIN AcademicYearStats AS ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY pts.TERM_CODE, ays.stddev_total_units DESC

WITH CurrentTermSummary AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), SubjectsInCurrentParamTerm AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.TERM_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, sicpt.SUBJECT_TITLE, sicpt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sicpt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sicpt.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, sicpt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sicpt.window_column FROM CurrentTermSummary AS cts JOIN SubjectsInCurrentParamTerm AS sicpt ON cts.TERM_CODE = sicpt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cts.TERM_CODE, sicpt.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH AcademicTermDetails AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), AcademicYearVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT atd.TERM_CODE, atd.TERM_PARAMETER, atd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atd.TERM_START_DATE, atd.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation FROM AcademicTermDetails AS atd JOIN AcademicYearVariation AS ayv ON atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atd.TERM_CODE

WITH subq1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.avg_total_units, subq1.stddev_total_units, subq2.TERM_CODE, subq2.TERM_PARAMETER, subq2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq1.stddev_total_units DESC, subq2.TERM_START_DATE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, t1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.window_column, s1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, s1.IS_REGULAR_TERM, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.benchmark_enrollment, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CurrentTermSummary AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), CurrentTermSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, csub.SUBJECT_TITLE, csub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, csub.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, csub.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, csub.window_column, csub.SUBJECT_ID FROM CurrentTermSummary AS cts JOIN CurrentTermSubjects AS csub ON cts.TERM_CODE = csub.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), TermInfo AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), DeptSubjects AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cco ON t0.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, t.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_PARAMETER, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.num_subjects FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TermInfo AS t ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DeptSubjects AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(d.num_subjects) FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DeptSubjects AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_CODE, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), AcademicYearVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0), DepartmentCounts AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON t0.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation, dc.num_departments FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN AcademicYearVariation AS ayv ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DepartmentCounts AS dc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms AS pts JOIN AcademicYearStats AS ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC

WITH SubjectMaxUnits AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE), TermUnitStats AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE s.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT smu.SUBJECT_CODE, smu.SUBJECT_NUMBER, smu.SUBJECT_TITLE, smu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, smu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, smu.TERM_CODE, smu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, smu.TERM_START_DATE, smu.max_total_units_3rows, tus.TERM_PARAMETER, tus.avg_total_units, tus.total_units_variance, tus.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectMaxUnits AS smu JOIN TermUnitStats AS tus ON smu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DeptCostStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT LIKE '%Mathematics%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date, dcs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptCostStats AS dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME, CIP.VERSION FROM `CIP` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(VERSION) AS avg_version FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_version AS school_avg_version, CASE WHEN i.VERSION > s.avg_version * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VERSION' WHEN i.VERSION < s.avg_version * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VERSION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS version_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY min_warehouse_load_date DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic WHERE ic.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.COURSE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY CATEGORY_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), SchoolTotals AS (SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.COURSE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.PROGRAM_CODE, i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_CODE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, i.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.PROGRAM_CODE, s.PROGRAM_TITLE, s.CATEGORY_CODE, s.CATEGORY_TITLE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s.min_warehouse_load_date, s.total_courses FROM SchoolTotals AS s ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, COURSE

WITH course_info AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), building_stats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC) SELECT ci.COURSE, ci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ci.SCHOOL_NAME, ci.PROGRAM_CODE, ci.PROGRAM_TITLE, ci.CATEGORY_CODE, ci.CATEGORY_TITLE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ci.min_warehouse_load_date, bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units FROM course_info AS ci JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON cso.SUBJECT_CODE = ci.COURSE JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE JOIN building_stats AS bs ON bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ci.CATEGORY_CODE, bs.stddev_total_units DESC

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), Dept6CourseCIP AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6) SELECT d6c.COURSE, d6c.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, d6c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d6c.SCHOOL_NAME, d6c.PROGRAM_CODE, d6c.PROGRAM_TITLE, d6c.CATEGORY_CODE, d6c.CATEGORY_TITLE, d6c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, d6c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, d6c.min_warehouse_load_date, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM Dept6CourseCIP AS d6c LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON d6c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d6c.CATEGORY_CODE, d6c.COURSE

WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), Sub2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.COURSE, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.PROGRAM_CODE, s1.PROGRAM_TITLE, s1.CATEGORY_CODE, s1.CATEGORY_TITLE, s1.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s1.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s1.min_warehouse_load_date, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.CATEGORY_CODE, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.COURSE) AS total_courses, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.min_budget_code, subq1.total_units_sum, subq1.unique_courses, subq2.total_courses, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.CATEGORY_CODE, subq2.min_warehouse_load_date FROM subq1 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.CATEGORY_CODE

WITH CourseCIPInfo AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3), DeptSubjectCount AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM DeptSubjectStats AS inner_cte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE) SELECT cci.COURSE, cci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cci.SCHOOL_NAME, cci.PROGRAM_CODE, cci.PROGRAM_TITLE, cci.CATEGORY_CODE, cci.CATEGORY_TITLE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, cci.min_warehouse_load_date, dsc.max_lecture_units, dsc.TERM_START_DATE, dsc.num_subjects_offered FROM CourseCIPInfo AS cci JOIN DeptSubjectCount AS dsc ON cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cci.min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY cci.CATEGORY_CODE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), dept_counts1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), SchoolTotals2 AS (SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.COURSE_NUMBER, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.window_column, NULL AS total_subjects, ic2.COURSE, ic2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic2.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.PROGRAM_CODE, ic2.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic2.CATEGORY_CODE, ic2.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic2.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic2.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ic1.COURSE_NUMBER
