sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID AS org_id FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeAssignableRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms AS r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.DLC_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, i.window_column, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.FLOOR, i.ROOM, i.SPACE_ID, i.AREA, i.MAJOR_USE, i.DESCRIPTION, i.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY

WITH org_space_units AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(SPACE_UNIT) OVER (PARTITION BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS total_space_units, DLC_KEY FROM (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT t0.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) AS inner_cte), org_hr_dept AS (SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, f.DLC_KEY FROM (SELECT f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS ic JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h2 ON ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f ON ic.ORGANIZATION = f.ORGANIZATION WHERE h2.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area') SELECT osu.ORGANIZATION_NAME, osu.DESCRIPTION, osu.SPACE_UNIT, osu.total_space_units, ohd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohd.organization_count, ohd.min_organization_number FROM org_space_units AS osu JOIN org_hr_dept AS ohd ON osu.DLC_KEY = ohd.DLC_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), Sub2 AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number, MAX(o.ORGANIZATION_SORT) AS max_organization_sort FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DLC_KEY, s1.window_column, s2.organization_count, s2.min_organization_number, ROUND(s2.organization_count / NULLIF(s2.min_organization_number, 0), 2) AS normalized_org_count, s2.max_organization_sort FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY AND s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, window_column, SUM(organization_count) AS total_organization_count, MIN(min_organization_number) AS min_organization_number, ROUND(SUM(organization_count) / NULLIF(MIN(min_organization_number), 0), 2) AS normalized_org_count, MAX(max_organization_sort) AS max_organization_sort FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(organization_count) > 0 ORDER BY normalized_org_count DESC

WITH OrgWindowRows AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), OrgAvgKey AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT owr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, owr.DESCRIPTION, owr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, owr.window_column AS org_window_row, oak.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, oak.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS avg_hr_org_unit_title, oak.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, oak.window_column AS avg_org_key FROM OrgWindowRows AS owr JOIN OrgAvgKey AS oak ON owr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oak.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY owr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oak.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, mo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, mo.Major_Org_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG) AS mo ON ic.DLC_KEY = mo.DLC_KEY AND ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = mo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND mo.rn = 1), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` WHERE NOT ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL AND NOT DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY) AS org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations) SELECT s1.DLC_KEY, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.organization_count, s1.min_organization_number, s1.Most_Prominent_Major_Org, s1.Major_Org_Count, s2.DLC_NAME, s2.org_count_range, s2.org_count_variance, s2.org_count_stddev, s2.total_organizations FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY s1.organization_count DESC

WITH orgs_with_parent AS (SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Org_Name, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION AS Org_Description, parent_org.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Parent_Org_Name, parent_org.DESCRIPTION AS Parent_Org_Description, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DESCRIPTION, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) AS inner_cte LEFT JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS parent_org ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY = parent_org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), orgs_with_rank AS (SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, fo.DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NOT_ASSIGNABLE' END AS assignable_status FROM (SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE') AS inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT owp.Org_Name, owp.Org_Description, owp.Parent_Org_Name, owp.Parent_Org_Description, owr.DLC_NAME, owr.window_column, owr.DESCRIPTION AS Org_Description_Rank, owr.assignable_status FROM orgs_with_parent AS owp JOIN orgs_with_rank AS owr ON owp.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = owr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME), Dept_Max_Org_Space AS (SELECT mdh.DLC_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS mdh JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT), Org_Earliest_Load AS (SELECT o.DLC_KEY, MIN(o.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS earliest_warehouse_load_date FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o GROUP BY o.DLC_KEY) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.DLC_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.assignable_organization_count, dmos.department, dmos.max_organization_number, dmos.space_unit_name, oel.earliest_warehouse_load_date FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN Dept_Max_Org_Space AS dmos ON ic.DLC_KEY = dmos.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN Org_Earliest_Load AS oel ON ic.DLC_KEY = oel.DLC_KEY

WITH OrgWindowed AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), OrgKeyStats AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column AS org_window_row_number, oks.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, oks.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, oks.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS oks_HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, oks.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, oks.window_column AS avg_org_key_window FROM OrgWindowed AS ow JOIN OrgKeyStats AS oks ON ow.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oks.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oks.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.space_unit_count, i.min_org_number, o.DLC_NAME, o.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON i.ORGANIZATION = o.ORGANIZATION), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS') SELECT subq1.ORGANIZATION, subq1.SPACE_UNIT, subq1.space_unit_count, subq1.min_org_number, subq1.DLC_NAME, subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, subq2.ORGANIZATION_ID, subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, subq2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DLC_KEY = subq2.DLC_KEY

WITH orgs_major_230 AS (SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, t2.DLC_KEY FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230), orgs_major_230_stats AS (SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, ic.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ic.DLC_KEY, AVG(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY ic.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, dept_stats.Top_Department, dept_stats.Department_Org_Count, ic.ORG_PARENT FROM orgs_major_230 AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Org_Count FROM orgs_major_230 AS ic2 GROUP BY ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orgs_major_230 AS ic3 WHERE ic3.ORG_PARENT = ic2.ORG_PARENT GROUP BY ic3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS sub)) AS dept_stats ON ic.ORG_PARENT = dept_stats.ORG_PARENT AND ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.Top_Department WHERE ic.ORG_PARENT IN (SELECT org_parent FROM (SELECT ic4.ORG_PARENT AS org_parent, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs FROM orgs_major_230 AS ic4 GROUP BY ic4.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY total_orgs DESC LIMIT 10) AS top_parents)), orgs_level_5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, t0.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), highest_hr_org_unit AS (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM orgs_level_5 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT o.ORG_PARENT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, o.Top_Department, o.Department_Org_Count, ol5.ORGANIZATION_ID, ol5.DLC_NAME, ol5.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hho.highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM orgs_major_230_stats AS o LEFT JOIN orgs_level_5 AS ol5 ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = ol5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND o.DLC_KEY = ol5.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN highest_hr_org_unit AS hho ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = hho.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY o.ORG_PARENT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME

WITH org_stats_by_dlc_orgname AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), prominent_major_org AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG), dlc_org_stats AS (SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY) AS ic JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` WHERE NOT ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL AND NOT DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY) AS org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations) SELECT o.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.organization_count, o.min_organization_number, pmo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, pmo.Major_Org_Count, d.DLC_NAME, d.org_count_range, d.org_count_variance, d.org_count_stddev, d.total_organizations FROM org_stats_by_dlc_orgname AS o LEFT JOIN prominent_major_org AS pmo ON o.DLC_KEY = pmo.DLC_KEY AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = pmo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND pmo.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats AS d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY o.organization_count DESC

WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), Sub2 AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DLC_KEY, s1.window_column, s2.organization_count, s2.min_organization_number, ROUND(s2.organization_count / NULLIF(s2.min_organization_number, 0), 2) AS normalized_org_count FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY AND s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY normalized_org_count DESC

WITH OrgSpaceWindow AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t0.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT t0.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')), OrgDlcStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.DESCRIPTION, ows.SPACE_UNIT, ows.window_column, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number FROM OrgSpaceWindow AS ows JOIN OrgDlcStats AS ods ON ows.DLC_KEY = ods.DLC_KEY AND ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.SPACE_UNIT

WITH OrgDlcStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC) SELECT ods.DLC_KEY, ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev FROM OrgDlcStats AS ods CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > 0.2), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC) SELECT subq1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, subq2.area_stddev, subq2.DLC_NAME FROM subq1 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON subq1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS fodk ON sd.DLC_KEY = fodk.DLC_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN subq2 ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY subq2.area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte1.subject_count, cte1.min_total_units, cte1.school_name, cte1.department_phone, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.dlc_key = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte2.area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 WHERE coefficient_of_variation > 0.2), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON sd.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN cte2 ON fo.DLC_KEY = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.coefficient_of_variation DESC, cte2.area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP), DepartmentSubjects AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY FROM cte1 AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomStats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, o2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte2.area_stddev DESC) SELECT ds.department, ds.grade_type, ds.subject_count, ds.min_total_units, ds.school_name, ds.department_phone, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, drs.area_stddev, drs.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name FROM DepartmentSubjects AS ds JOIN DepartmentRoomStats AS drs ON ds.DLC_KEY = drs.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ds.department, ds.grade_type, drs.area_stddev DESC

WITH area_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC), hr_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_hr_departments, fo.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.num_hr_org_units DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.area_stddev, a.DLC_NAME, h.num_hr_org_units, h.num_hr_departments FROM area_stats AS a JOIN hr_stats AS h ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = h.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND a.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME AND a.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY h.num_hr_org_units DESC, a.area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NULL AND NOT t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')), DepartmentRoomAreaStddev AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomCount AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o1.ORGANIZATION_ID, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o1.MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, d2.area_stddev, d3.total_room_count FROM inner_cte AS o1 LEFT JOIN DepartmentRoomAreaStddev AS d2 ON o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = d2.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN DepartmentRoomCount AS d3 ON o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = d3.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY o1.ORGANIZATION_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC) SELECT os.DLC_KEY, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM OrgStats AS os JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON os.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT os.DLC_KEY, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM OrgStats AS os JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON os.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.min_organization_number, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, CASE WHEN inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA >= 100000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA >= 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS building_size_category FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_long) OVER (ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort) = dept_long THEN NULL ELSE dept_long END AS department_long_name, hier3_name, org_count, min_org_unit_id, max_load_date FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS hier3_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS hier3_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, DLC_Count.Total_Space_Units FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS Total_Space_Units FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 GROUP BY t0.DLC_KEY) AS DLC_Count ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = DLC_Count.DLC_KEY

WITH AreaRooms AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_TYPE, MIN(t1.FLOOR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 400), E_BuildingRooms AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t2.AREA, t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_CODE, t1.DLC_KEY, MIN(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.DLC_KEY) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t1 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t2 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_ROOM LIKE 'E%' AND t2.AREA > 50), CombinedRooms AS (SELECT ar.BUILDING_ROOM, ar.FLOOR, ar.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ar.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ar.BUILDING_NAME, ar.BUILDING_TYPE, ar.window_column AS area_window_min_floor, NULL AS FCLT_ROOM_KEY, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS DEPT_CODE, NULL AS DLC_KEY, NULL AS dlc_window_min_area, 'AreaRooms' AS Source FROM AreaRooms AS ar UNION ALL SELECT eb.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, eb.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS BUILDING_NAME, NULL AS BUILDING_TYPE, NULL AS area_window_min_floor, eb.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, eb.AREA, eb.DEPT_CODE, eb.DLC_KEY, eb.window_column AS dlc_window_min_area, 'E_BuildingRooms' AS Source FROM E_BuildingRooms AS eb) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, area_window_min_floor, FCLT_ROOM_KEY, AREA, DEPT_CODE, DLC_KEY, dlc_window_min_area, Source FROM CombinedRooms ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM

sources.sql: WITH dept_subjects_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS SCD JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS SCD JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE, CCSO.SUBJECT_TITLE, CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS SCD JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN dept_avg_units AS DAU ON SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME = DAU.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS > DAU.avg_units), room_area_above_dept_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.AREA, t1.DEPT_CODE FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPT_CODE, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPT_CODE) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.FLOOR, i.MAJOR_USE_DESC, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_KEY, i.AREA, i.DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE WHERE i.AREA > d.avg_area) SELECT dsa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsa.SUBJECT_CODE, dsa.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsa.TOTAL_UNITS, raa.BUILDING_ROOM, raa.FLOOR, raa.MAJOR_USE_DESC, raa.ORGANIZATION_NAME, raa.DLC_KEY, raa.AREA FROM dept_subjects_above_avg AS dsa JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON dsa.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN room_area_above_dept_avg AS raa ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = raa.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY dsa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsa.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, raa.AREA DESC

sources.sql: WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms, inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) AS sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.Total_Rooms, b.BUILDING_NAME, s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 'Large_Accessible_Room' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS Total_Rooms, s2.BUILDING_NAME, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 'Top_Building_Area_Range' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, Total_Rooms, BUILDING_NAME, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME, Reason

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), avg_major_use AS (SELECT FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` WHERE ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY), subquery1 AS (SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA, i.DESCRIPTION, (i.AREA - a.avg_area) AS deviation_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_major_use AS a ON i.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = a.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY), subquery2_base AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.AREA FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38'), avg_dept_area AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM subquery2_base GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NUMBER), subquery2 AS (SELECT s2b.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS DESCRIPTION, (s2b.AREA - ada.avg_area) AS deviation_column, s2b.FLOOR, s2b.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2b.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2b.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2b.FULL_NAME, s2b.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subquery2_base AS s2b JOIN avg_dept_area AS ada ON s2b.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = ada.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER), CombinedRooms AS (SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.DESCRIPTION, s1.deviation_column, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS OFFICE_LOCATION, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'AccessLevel1' AS Reason FROM subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.AREA, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.deviation_column, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'E38Rooms' AS Reason FROM subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedRooms ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.AREA, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300), DeptAvg AS (SELECT DEPT_CODE, AVG(AREA) AS dept_avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPT_CODE HAVING AVG(AREA) > 400) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DLC_KEY, ic.window_avg_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptAvg AS da ON ic.DEPT_CODE = da.DEPT_CODE

sources.sql: WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), DeptProvostArea AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column AS org_window_column, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_window_column FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN DeptProvostArea AS d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY AND o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_hr_org_unit_load_date FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id

WITH dept_ranks AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS t0 INNER JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area') SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME LIKE '%Science%'), org_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) SELECT org_stats.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_stats.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, org_stats.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, org_stats.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, org_stats.window_column AS ORG_KEY_AVG, org_stats.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, org_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, dept_ranks.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, dept_ranks.window_column AS DEPT_RANK FROM org_stats JOIN dept_ranks ON org_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_ranks.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(LENGTH(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME)) AS longest_department_name_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, s1.window_column, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.longest_department_name_length FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(LENGTH(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME)) AS longest_department_name_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, s1.window_column, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS longest_department_name_length, 'Windowed' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.longest_department_name_length, 'LongestDeptName' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_long) OVER (ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort) = dept_long THEN NULL ELSE dept_long END AS department_long_name, hier3_name, org_count, min_org_unit_id, max_load_date FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS hier3_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS hier3_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.min_org_unit_id, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS') SELECT s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name, s1.org_count, s1.min_org_unit_id, s1.max_load_date, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.department_long_name = s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND s1.hier3_name = s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AND s1.min_org_unit_id = s2.min_org_unit_id ORDER BY s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id, f.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY), dept_subdept_stats AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments, m.DLC_KEY FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY) AS sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT m.DLC_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_subdept_stats AS d ON i.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS su JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC), OrgStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC), CombinedStats AS (SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old, s.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN OrgStats AS o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(cs.SPACE_UNIT) OVER (ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) = cs.SPACE_UNIT THEN NULL ELSE cs.SPACE_UNIT END AS SPACE_UNIT, cs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cs.avg_hr_dept_code, cs.hr_dept_code_range, cs.hr_dept_code_variance, cs.avg_dept_code_old, cs.var_dept_code_old, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM CombinedStats AS cs JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON cs.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_hr_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NULL AND NOT t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, i.max_hr_org_unit_id, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.max_hr_org_unit_id = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY icte.window_column DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.total_max_enrollment, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, ActivityCounts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) AS ActivityCounts ON inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ActivityCounts.ENROLLMENT_TYPE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_max_enrollment) AS avg_total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.activity_count, i.total_max_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_max_enrollment > a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.total_max_enrollment < a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY CASE WHEN IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, var_max_enrollment DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

`ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CategorySponsorStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.TERM_START_DATE, a.Total_Activities, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, c.avg_fee, c.total_activities FROM ActivityStats AS a JOIN CategorySponsorStats AS c ON a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR), TermSubjectInfo AS (SELECT t.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_ids, MIN(i.PREREG_DEADLINE) AS earliest_prereg_deadline FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS i ON t.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(icte.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year, tsi.unique_subject_ids, tsi.earliest_prereg_deadline FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON icte.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date JOIN TermSubjectInfo AS tsi ON icte.TERM_CODE = tsi.TERM_CODE ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC

s2.department_phone, s2.school_name FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE IAP_CATEGORY_NAME END AS IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 0 AND sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON` AS p JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE) SELECT cte.PERSON_ROLE, cte.avg_max_enrollment, cte.max_enrollment_range, cte.max_enrollment_variance, CASE WHEN cte.avg_max_enrollment > overall.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN cte.avg_max_enrollment < overall.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) AS overall ORDER BY cte.max_enrollment_range DESC

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte.SESSION_TITLE, cte.SESSION_LOCATION, cte.SESSION_DATE, cte.SESSION_START_TIME, cte.SESSION_END_TIME, cte.min_start_time_per_location, dr.window_column, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) AS dr ON cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = dr.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND cte.TERM_CODE = dr.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cte.SESSION_LOCATION
