sources.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_clearing_cost_collector, ic.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 AS ic) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.GRADUATE_LEVEL, s1.num_distinct_courses, s2.total_clearing_cost_collector, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.GRADUATE_LEVEL

WITH student_info AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED`), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units, d.benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, d.variability_category FROM student_info AS s JOIN dept_variability AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE), variance_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_stats), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), admin_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vs.enrolled_students_variance, vs.enrolled_students_stddev, vs.variance_category, ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ast.coefficient_of_variation, ast.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variance_stats AS vs JOIN admin_stats AS ast ON vs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY vs.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DepartmentUnitsEnriched AS (SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), SchoolClearingCostStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT due.DEPARTMENT_NAME, due.avg_total_units, due.range_total_units, due.var_total_units, due.SCHOOL_NAME, due.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sccs.total_clearing_cost_collector FROM DepartmentUnitsEnriched AS due LEFT JOIN SchoolClearingCostStats AS sccs ON due.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY due.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, inner_cte1.total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte1 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), cte2 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS ic LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, cte1.total_clearing_cost_collector, cte2.stddev_total_units, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, inner_cte.total_clearing_cost_collector FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), DeptSchoolRollup AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, subject_count FROM DeptSchoolRollup ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, s1.total_clearing_cost_collector, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS subject_count, 'DegreeGrantingDept' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, NULL AS total_clearing_cost_collector, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.subject_count, 'MathSubjects2024' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, total_clearing_cost_collector, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, subject_count, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE

WITH student_info AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED`), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units, d.benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, d.variability_category FROM student_info AS s JOIN dept_variability AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME

WITH DeptBudgetStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.dept_budget_code_stddev, d1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.avg_total_units, d2.range_total_units, d2.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM DeptBudgetStddev AS d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH course_desc_stats AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), top_math_courses AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code, scd.FROM_TERM, scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM top_math_courses AS tmc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN course_desc_stats AS cds ON scd.COURSE = cds.COURSE AND cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code, scd.FROM_TERM, scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.FROM_TERM) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(COURSE_NUMBER) OVER (ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM) = COURSE_NUMBER THEN NULL ELSE COURSE_NUMBER END AS COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, offer_count, DEPARTMENT_NAME, course_description_count, min_cip_program_code, FROM_TERM, FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM

WITH highest_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_term FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment_per_term) AS highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.distinct_course_options, hae.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM course_stats AS cs JOIN highest_avg_enrollment AS hae ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_units, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON inner_cte.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY = scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = 18 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_subject_codes FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.SCHOOL_NAME = i.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = c.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_courses ORDER BY i.num_courses DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, s2.num_courses, s2.num_subject_codes FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t0 JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NULL AND NOT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL), eng_degree_courses AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), subject_course_counts AS (SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(edc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS degree_course_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN eng_degree_courses AS edc ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = edc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME), most_recent_course AS (SELECT edc.SUBJECT_CODE, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY edc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM eng_degree_courses AS edc) SELECT scc.SUBJECT_CODE, scc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scc.degree_course_count, mrc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mrc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mrc.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM subject_course_counts AS scc LEFT JOIN most_recent_course AS mrc ON scc.SUBJECT_CODE = mrc.SUBJECT_CODE AND mrc.rn = 1 ORDER BY scc.degree_course_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.min_total_units_per_dept, NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, NULL AS OFFER_COUNT, '12-unit 2022 Degree-Granting Subject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS min_total_units_per_dept, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.offer_count, 'Top 3 Most Frequently Offered Mathematics Course' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COURSE_LEVEL, SCHOOL_NAME, min_total_units_per_dept, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_COUNT, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH GraduateMathCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, t0.CATEGORY_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.COURSE) AS window_column FROM `CIP` AS t0 INNER JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), MathDeptGeometricMean AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC) SELECT gmc.COURSE, gmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmc.PROGRAM_TITLE, gmc.CATEGORY_TITLE, gmc.window_column, mdgm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM GraduateMathCourses AS gmc JOIN MathDeptGeometricMean AS mdgm ON gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY gmc.COURSE

WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), DeptUnitsVariance AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.SCHOOL_NAME, mc.COURSE_LEVEL, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.TOTAL_UNITS, mc.GRADE_TYPE, mc.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, duv.total_units_variance FROM MathCourses AS mc JOIN DeptUnitsVariance AS duv ON mc.DEPARTMENT = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

WITH inner_cte_math AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), avg_cip_math AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_cip FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), math_courses_filtered AS (SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte_math AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cip_math AS a WHERE i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > a.avg_cip), inner_cte_units AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), units_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, (inner_cte.avg_total_units - overall.avg_all_departments) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte_units AS inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_all_departments FROM (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs) AS overall) SELECT mcf.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.SCHOOL_NAME, mcf.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_variance, us.total_units_stddev, us.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM math_courses_filtered AS mcf JOIN units_stats AS us ON mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME = us.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.total_units_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(course_description_count) AS total_course_descriptions, MIN(min_cip_program_code) AS min_cip_program_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_description_count) > 0), Subquery1 AS (SELECT rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.COURSE, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_course_descriptions, rr.min_cip_program_code FROM RollupResults AS rr), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS graduate_student_count, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.graduate_student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS num_graduate_courses, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.graduate_student_count, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte2.graduate_student_count DESC LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.COURSE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_course_descriptions, s1.min_cip_program_code, NULL AS graduate_student_count, NULL AS num_graduate_courses FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS COURSE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_course_descriptions, NULL AS min_cip_program_code, s2.graduate_student_count, s2.num_graduate_courses FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE

WITH school_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, AVG(dept_subject_counts.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, ss.avg_subject_codes_per_department, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.course_count, mcs.min_total_units, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, mcs.distinct_course_options FROM school_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN math_course_stats AS mcs

WITH highest_avg_enrollment_per_term_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_term FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment_per_term) AS highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), course_stats_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT csc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, csc.COURSE_LEVEL, csc.course_count, csc.min_total_units, csc.SCHOOL_NAME, csc.distinct_course_options, hap.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM course_stats_cte AS csc JOIN highest_avg_enrollment_per_term_cte AS hap ON csc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hap.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY csc.COURSE_LEVEL

WITH school_cip AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS school_max_cip_code, CASE WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) > 150000 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) < 130000 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CIP' END AS cip_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK), math_iap_enroll AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.stddev_max_enrollment, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, sc.school_max_cip_code, sc.cip_category, mie.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mie.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mie.stddev_max_enrollment, mie.department_phone FROM school_cip AS sc JOIN math_iap_enroll AS mie ON sc.SCHOOL_NAME = mie.school_name WHERE sc.school_max_cip_code > 130000 AND NOT mie.stddev_max_enrollment IS NULL ORDER BY sc.SCHOOL_NAME, mie.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), DepartmentCIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo AS si LEFT JOIN DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS department_name, dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, NULL AS student_full_name, NULL AS student_email_address, NULL AS school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs WHERE NOT dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM StudentInfo)) SELECT department_name, department_full_name, student_full_name, student_email_address, school_code_dense_rank, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY department_full_name, student_full_name

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000), DepartmentMaxCIP AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.max_cip_code, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_full_name FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) > 0), SchoolBudgetStats AS (SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.dept_budget_code_stddev, icte.school_full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.dept_budget_code_stddev, icte.school_full_name) SELECT dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmc.max_cip_code, dmc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dmc.SCHOOL_NAME, sbs.dept_budget_code_stddev, sbs.school_full_name, sbs.unique_subject_codes FROM DepartmentMaxCIP AS dmc JOIN SchoolBudgetStats AS sbs ON dmc.SCHOOL_NAME = sbs.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmc.max_cip_code DESC

WITH SchoolCIP AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS school_max_cip_code, CASE WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) > 150000 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) < 130000 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CIP' END AS cip_category, i.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, i.SCHOOL_CODE), MathIAPStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.stddev_max_enrollment, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, sc.school_max_cip_code, sc.cip_category, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.stddev_max_enrollment, ms.department_phone FROM SchoolCIP AS sc JOIN MathIAPStats AS ms ON sc.SCHOOL_CODE = ms.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sc.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH student_info AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), student_info_with_admin AS (SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_info AS si LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), school_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_units) AS school_avg_units, VARIANCE(ic.avg_units) AS school_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE NOT d.SCHOOL_CODE IN (SELECT SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7') GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.school_avg_units, sus.school_units_variance FROM student_info_with_admin AS s LEFT JOIN school_units_stats AS sus ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = sus.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH SchoolCIP AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS school_max_cip_code, CASE WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) > 150000 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) < 130000 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CIP' END AS cip_category, i.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, i.SCHOOL_CODE), MathDeptTopSubject AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, sc.school_max_cip_code, sc.cip_category, mdts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdts.SCHOOL_NAME AS MATH_SCHOOL_NAME, mdts.SUBJECT_CODE, mdts.subject_course_count FROM SchoolCIP AS sc LEFT JOIN MathDeptTopSubject AS mdts ON sc.SCHOOL_NAME = mdts.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sc.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS max_cip_code, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK

WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), CIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, cs.cip_code_range, cs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo AS si LEFT JOIN CIPStats AS cs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH TotalDegreeGrantingCourses AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(scd.COURSE) AS total_degree_granting_courses, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_CODE <> 'Z' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(scd.COURSE) > 0), DepartmentSubjectInfo AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.total_degree_granting_courses, dsi.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dsi.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsi.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dsi.SCHOOL_NAME AS DEPT_SCHOOL_NAME, dsi.window_column FROM TotalDegreeGrantingCourses AS t JOIN DepartmentSubjectInfo AS dsi ON t.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsi.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t.SCHOOL_NAME, dsi.window_column

WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), DepartmentCIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo AS si JOIN DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY si.school_code_dense_rank, si.student_full_name

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t0 JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NULL AND NOT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) LIKE '%ENGINEERING%'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, (sos.TOTAL_UNITS - AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.window_column, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.total_units_variance, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.deviation_from_dept_avg FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT * FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED`)) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.var_enrolled_students FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT * FROM inner_cte) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_course_count, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS sq1 JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON sq1.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN Subquery2 AS sq2 ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = sq2.SCHOOL_NAME), school_avg_units AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_dept_budget_code, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < s.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_LOAD' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg_units AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH department_max_units AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), eecs_students_courses AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, esc.window_column, esc.COURSE FROM department_max_units AS dmu JOIN eecs_students_courses AS esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON icte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH DegreeGrantingCourses AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(scd.COURSE) AS total_degree_granting_courses FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_CODE <> 'Z' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scd.COURSE) > 0), MathSubjects2014FA AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT dgc.SCHOOL_NAME, dgc.total_degree_granting_courses, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.window_column FROM DegreeGrantingCourses AS dgc JOIN MathSubjects2014FA AS ms ON dgc.SCHOOL_NAME = ms.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY dgc.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.window_column

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROUND(s2.TOTAL_UNITS / NULLIF(s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0), 2) AS Units_Per_Enrolled_Student FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.cip_code_variance ORDER BY ic.cip_code_variance DESC) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_course_count, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.cip_code_variance FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_num_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_num_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT * FROM inner_cte) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_enrolled_students, s1.stddev_num_enrolled_students, s1.avg_num_enrolled_students, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.window_column FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.window_column

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t1 JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.geometric_mean_total_units, subq1.avg_enrolled_students, subq2.highest_enrollment FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH political_science_subjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), department_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME), department_school_phone AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dsp.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM political_science_subjects GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0) AS ps LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON ps.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN department_units_stats AS dus ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN department_school_phone AS dsp ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsp.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.SPACE_USAGE, MIN(t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_detail_load_date, t1.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_usage_load_date FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_USAGE` AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = t1.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE t0.ROOM_NUMBER = '21E') SELECT * FROM inner_cte
