sources.sql: WITH avg_stats AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC), eo_materials AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO') SELECT eo_materials.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eo_materials.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eo_materials.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eo_materials.TERM_CODE, eo_materials.SUBJECT_ID, eo_materials.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eo_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eo_materials.TERM_PARAMETER, eo_materials.window_column, avg_stats.avg_materials_per_subject, avg_stats.variance_materials_per_subject, avg_stats.stddev_materials_per_subject FROM eo_materials LEFT JOIN avg_stats ON eo_materials.TERM_PARAMETER = avg_stats.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY eo_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eo_materials.window_column

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), avg_units AS (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT s1.academic_year, s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.material_count, s1.min_term_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.units_deviation FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.academic_year, s1.min_term_code

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS l JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, ReserveCounts.Total_Reserve_Materials FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS Total_Reserve_Materials FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID) AS ReserveCounts ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ReserveCounts.SUBJECT_ID), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, term_code, term_description, record_count_variance, record_count_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_code_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, VARIANCE(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(record_count_stddev) AS record_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort) SELECT s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s1.Total_Reserve_Materials, s2.academic_year, s2.academic_year_desc, s2.term_code, s2.term_description, s2.record_count_variance, s2.record_count_stddev FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.term_code

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), subquery2 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), CombinedResults AS (SELECT 'Highest Variance Year' AS Result_Type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS material_count, NULL AS min_term_code FROM subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Textbook Materials' AS Result_Type, s2.academic_year, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS record_count_variance, NULL AS Most_Represented_Department, NULL AS Subject_Count, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.material_count, s2.min_term_code FROM subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Result_Type, academic_year, min_term_code

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE HAVING SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) > 0) SELECT ic.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, ic.total_records, AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON ic.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY ic.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, ic.total_records HAVING AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) > 20

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.PUBLISHER, i.material_count, i.min_used_price, s.avg_new_shelf_price AS benchmark_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.min_used_price < s.avg_new_shelf_price * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_USED_PRICE' WHEN i.min_used_price > s.avg_new_shelf_price * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_USED_PRICE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USED_PRICE' END AS used_price_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) AS s ON i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AND i.PUBLISHER = s.PUBLISHER

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE HAVING SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) > 0), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE), overall_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_records) AS avg_total_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, i.total_records, b.avg_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.total_records > ob.avg_total_records * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_RECORDS' WHEN i.total_records < ob.avg_total_records * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_RECORDS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS records_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN benchmark_cte AS b ON i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = b.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS ob

sources.sql: WITH MaterialStats AS (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price, d.TERM_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, d.TERM_CODE), DepartmentUnits AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, c.TERM_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TERM_CODE) SELECT ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.PUBLISHER, ms.material_count, ms.min_used_price, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance FROM MaterialStats AS ms JOIN DepartmentUnits AS du ON ms.TERM_CODE = du.TERM_CODE

WITH Subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte), Subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_stats.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS avg_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.min_record_count, s1.total_new_shelf_price, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.max_enrollment, inner_cte2.TERM_START_DATE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, ss.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte1.min_record_count, inner_cte1.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte1 ON ss.SUBJECT_ID = inner_cte1.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0), subject_offered_summary AS (SELECT CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dsc.num_subjects, ict.SUBJECT_ID FROM DeptSubjectCounts AS dsc LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 AS ict ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ict.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT sos.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sos.num_subjects, ic2.min_record_count, ic2.total_new_shelf_price FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ic2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

sources.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, s2.min_record_count, s2.total_new_shelf_price FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subject_offered_key) OVER (ORDER BY subject_id_sort, subject_offered_key_sort) = subject_offered_key THEN NULL ELSE subject_offered_key END AS subject_offered_key, subject_id, material_count, total_new_shelf_price, avg_used_shelf_price FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS subject_offered_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS subject_offered_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SUBJECT_ID END AS subject_id_sort, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY subject_id_sort, subject_offered_key_sort

WITH cv_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), avg_cv AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_cv AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv), materials_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation, materials_cte.highest_material_count_for_status FROM cv_cte JOIN materials_cte ON cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = materials_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), material_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte AS evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte AS mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) SELECT department_name, material_status_description, material_count FROM (SELECT department_name, material_status_description, material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_name ORDER BY material_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 10 AND department_name IN (SELECT department_name FROM (SELECT department_name, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name) AS dept_totals WHERE total_materials > (SELECT AVG(total_materials) FROM (SELECT department_name, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name) AS all_depts)) ORDER BY department_name, material_count DESC

SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Biology' AND (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), course_counts AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS cd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.avg_subject_codes, scs.stddev_subject_codes, cc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN subject_code_stats AS scs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN course_counts AS cc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, scs.avg_subject_codes DESC

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'), math_units_variation AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), chem_tip_materials AS (SELECT t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t LEFT JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON t.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AND t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID), chem_subjects_with_materials AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.window_column, i.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID, COALESCE(m.num_tip_materials, 0) AS num_tip_materials FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' LEFT JOIN chem_tip_materials AS m ON t.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = m.SUBJECT_ID), avg_materials_per_year AS (SELECT mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(csm.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials_per_chem_subject FROM math_units_variation AS mv CROSS JOIN chem_subjects_with_materials AS csm GROUP BY mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT csm.SUBJECT_TITLE, csm.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, csm.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, csm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, csm.window_column, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mv.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, csm.num_tip_materials, avgm.avg_tip_materials_per_chem_subject FROM chem_subjects_with_materials AS csm CROSS JOIN math_units_variation AS mv LEFT JOIN avg_materials_per_year AS avgm ON mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avgm.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avgm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_TERM_CODE, icte.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT icte.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(icte.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Room_Count, AVG(icte.FLOOR) AS Avg_Floor, org_stats.Top_Organization_Name, org_stats.Org_Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT icte2.SPACE_USAGE, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Top_Organization_Name, COUNT(icte2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Org_Room_Count, @rank := CASE WHEN @current_usage = icte2.SPACE_USAGE THEN @rank + 1 ELSE 1 END AS `Rank`, @current_usage := icte2.SPACE_USAGE FROM (SELECT SPACE_USAGE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM FROM inner_cte) AS icte2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_usage := '') AS vars GROUP BY icte2.SPACE_USAGE, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte2.SPACE_USAGE, Org_Room_Count DESC) AS org_stats ON icte.SPACE_USAGE = org_stats.SPACE_USAGE AND org_stats.`Rank` = 1 GROUP BY icte.SPACE_USAGE, org_stats.Top_Organization_Name, org_stats.Org_Room_Count ORDER BY Room_Count DESC LIMIT 10

sources.sql: WITH OrgAccessStats AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC), RoomDetails AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT rd.BUILDING_ROOM, rd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, rd.FLOOR, rd.SPACE_USAGE, rd.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rd.window_column, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev FROM RoomDetails AS rd JOIN OrgAccessStats AS oas ON rd.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = oas.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY rd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rd.BUILDING_ROOM

sources.sql: WITH building_room_stats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC), room_access_info AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.avg_room_area, brs.room_area_range, brs.room_area_variance, rai.BUILDING_ROOM, rai.BUILDING_COMPONENT, rai.FLOOR, rai.SPACE_USAGE, rai.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rai.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rai.window_column FROM building_room_stats AS brs JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON brs.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN room_access_info AS rai ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = rai.BUILDING_ROOM

sources.sql: WITH RoomsOnFloor2Access1 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t0.FLOOR, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_access_level, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 AND t0.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), DeptHierarchyAgg AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.BUILDING_COMPONENT, r.FLOOR, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, r.ACCESS_LEVEL, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.ORGANIZATION, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, r.min_access_level, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.org_count, d.min_org_unit_id FROM RoomsOnFloor2Access1 AS r LEFT JOIN DeptHierarchyAgg AS d ON r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = d.min_org_unit_id ORDER BY r.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

sources.sql: WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM

sources.sql: WITH BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC), RoomAccessStats AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ras.FLOOR, ras.SPACE_USAGE, ras.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.window_column, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.avg_room_area, brs.room_area_range, brs.room_area_variance, ROUND(ras.window_column / NULLIF(brs.avg_room_area, 0), 2) AS normalized_floor_to_area FROM RoomAccessStats AS ras JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON ras.BUILDING_ROOM = fr.BUILDING_ROOM JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs ON fb.BUILDING_NAME = brs.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY normalized_floor_to_area DESC

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT cr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, cr.DESCRIPTION, cr.SPACE_UNIT, cr.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, cr.org_window_column, cr.BUILDING_ROOM, cr.SPACE_USAGE, cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, cr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cr.room_window_column, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM CombinedResults AS cr JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH BuildingAreaStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC), RoomAccessLevel1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bal.BUILDING_NUMBER, bal.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column, fr.AREA, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingAreaStddev AS bal JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON bal.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessLevel1 AS ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM), BuildingAvgArea AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.area_stddev, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.BUILDING_COMPONENT, i.FLOOR, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN BuildingAvgArea AS baa ON i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = baa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE i.AREA > baa.avg_area ORDER BY i.area_stddev DESC, i.FLOOR

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic year where the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, and for each subject in the term "2010FA" that is a regular term, show the previous term code, previous term description, previous academic year, the running sum of academic years for previous terms, the financial aid year, the subject ID, the subject's term description, the material status key, the subject's academic year, and the rank of the subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID. The results are ordered by financial aid year, previous academic year, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous')), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: List, for each academic year, either (1) the top 10 academic years by the number of subjects offered in the fall term by the Mathematics department (including the academic year, academic year description, term description, number of subjects, term start date, and term end date), or (2) for each administrative department and academic year, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department in that year (including the academic year, administrative department name, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), school name, and department phone number), and indicate the reason for inclusion ('MathFallSubjects' for the first case and 'DeptUnitsStats' for the second case). The selected columns should appear in the following order: academic year, academic year description, term description, number of subjects, term start date, term end date, administrative department name, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), school name, department phone number, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH MathFallSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), DeptUnitsStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mfs.num_subjects, mfs.TERM_START_DATE, mfs.TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'MathFallSubjects' AS Reason FROM MathFallSubjects AS mfs UNION ALL SELECT dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS num_subjects, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TERM_END_DATE, dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_DESCRIPTION, num_subjects, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic term that is not cancelled, has at least one IAP subject activity with a non-null maximum enrollment, and where the term status is 'Previous', provide the term description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment values for IAP subject activities in that term, the academic year description, the term code, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the academic year, and the last day of final exam, ordered by the range of maximum enrollment in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION), Subquery1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON icte.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.max_enrollment_range, s1.max_enrollment_variance, s1.max_enrollment_stddev, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.CALENDAR_DATE, s2.DAY_OF_WEEK, s2.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.max_enrollment_range DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, the description of the academic year, the department name, the average total units for all subjects offered by that department in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P', and the deviation of each department's average total units from the overall average total units for that academic year, along with, for each subject offered in the library by that department in that academic year during regular terms, the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, the academic year of the subject, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, and the responsible faculty name, considering only subjects offered in the 'Mathematics' department during regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units, (inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS overall ON inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = overall.ACADEMIC_YEAR), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON inner_cte2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.dept_avg_total_units, cte1.deviation_from_overall_avg, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, cte2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (for records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900, and the geometric mean of the financial aid year from all academic terms where the financial aid year is greater than 1900. Also, include the reason for inclusion ('MaterialsPerSubject' for the geometric mean of materials per subject, 'DegreeYear' for the geometric mean of degree year, and 'FinancialAidYear' for the geometric mean of financial aid year). Show the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of materials per subject, geometric mean of degree year, geometric mean of financial aid year, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CombinedGeometricMeans AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'MaterialsPerSubject' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'DegreeYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDegreeYear UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'FinancialAidYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, Reason FROM CombinedGeometricMeans ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for its subjects in regular terms that are not the current term, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (considering only departments that have more than five subjects offered in 2022, are degree-granting, and are not the Chemistry department)? Show the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for regular non-current terms, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH MathDeptStddev AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptStddev2022 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dsd.total_units_stddev AS dept_stddev_2022 FROM MathDeptStddev AS mds LEFT JOIN DeptStddev2022 AS dsd ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5) that has course materials, show the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key, along with the minimum academic year and average total units for the corresponding academic term in the Mathematics department, where the academic year is between 2000 and 2020 or the total units are at least 6, and the total units are between 1 and 12. Also, include the term description and the first day of classes for each term from the academic terms table. The results are ordered by term code and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS css JOIN MathTermStats AS mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For academic years where the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, and for each subject in the term "2010FA" that is a regular term, provide the previous term code, previous term description, previous academic year, running sum of academic years within the financial aid year group, financial aid year, subject ID, subject term description, material status key, subject academic year, and the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic year where the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, and for each subject in the term "2010FA" within that academic year where the term is a regular term, list the term code, the previous term description, the previous academic year, the running sum of academic years, the financial aid year, the subject ID, the subject's term description, the material status key, the subject's academic year, the rank of the subject within the academic year group, and the normalized ratio of the running sum to the subject rank rounded (running sum divided by subject rank), ordered by financial aid year, previous academic year, and subject ID.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous')), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK, ROUND(s1.window_column / NULLIF(s2.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_RunningSum_to_SubjectRank FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department this year and letter graded, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, the academic year description from the academic terms table, and for the same academic year, also show the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in regular terms that start after January 1, 2010. List the columns in the following order: subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, maximum total units for 3 rows, academic year description, total units range, and total units variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_total_units_3rows, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT total_units_range IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.max_total_units_3rows, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 academic years by the number of subjects offered in the fall term by the Mathematics department, provide for each academic year and term: the academic year, academic year description, term description, number of subjects, term start date, term end date, and for each administrative department in that year (excluding Mechanical Engineering and only including degree-granting departments with courses of total units greater than 0), the administrative department name, average total units, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, school name, and department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), cte1 AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR), cte2 AS (SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.num_subjects, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.total_units_variance, cte2.total_units_stddev, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.num_subjects DESC, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered by the Mathematics department that is letter graded and offered this year, and for each subject in the "Engineering" school with total units greater than 1 and in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department (Course 6), where both are offered in the same term that is a regular term, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, and the maximum total units for each Mathematics subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, as well as the school name, academic year description, term start date, term end date, and the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS for the Engineering subject. The columns should be listed in the following order: subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, academic year, term code, term description, maximum total units (for Mathematics subject), school name, academic year description, term start date, term end date, and windowed minimum total units (for Engineering subject). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH math_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.max_total_units_3rows FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.TERM_CODE), eng_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.TERM_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.TERM_CODE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.max_total_units_3rows, e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.TERM_START_DATE, e.TERM_END_DATE, e.window_column FROM math_cte AS m JOIN eng_cte AS e ON m.TERM_CODE =
