target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 3 most frequently offered IAP activities that are not cancelled, provide the activity title, max enrollment, the term description, the academic year description, the term start and end dates, and for the corresponding academic year, the maximum and minimum of the variance of record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'). List the columns in the following order: activity title, max enrollment, term description, academic year description, term start date, term end date, maximum variance of record counts, and minimum variance of record counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3), cte1 AS (SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ta.TERM_START_DATE, ta.TERM_END_DATE, ta.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ta ON ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ta.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), cte2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC) SELECT cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.max_record_count_variance, cte2.min_record_count_variance FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: List the subject titles, department names, term codes, term descriptions, academic years, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, and the number of reserve materials assigned for the top 10 subject titles by reserve materials in academic terms with status 'Previous', and also show the corresponding academic year description and the last day of final exam for each term. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, ts.num_reserve_materials FROM TopSubjects AS ts JOIN PreviousTerms AS pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.num_reserve_materials, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department (Chemistry or Biology) and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, and for academic years where the average total units for Mathematics subjects in non-summer, non-current terms is greater than the overall average total units for all subjects in such terms, provide the department, academic year, subject count, minimum start date of the term, average subject count for that department, whether the subject count is above, below, or within 10% of the average, the academic year description, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for Mathematics subjects in that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic term where the term status indicator is 'P' and the term parameter is 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM', what are the academic terms key, term description, academic year description, term start date, term end date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the term code, the total number of academic terms per academic year, and the maximum average subject enrollment number for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term and have more than 0 total units, with all results grouped and ordered by academic year description and term start date? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH max_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS subq GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_avg_subject_enrollment DESC), term_window_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Terms.Total_Terms_Per_Year, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.TERM_CODE) AS Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 GROUP BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Total_Terms ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT tws.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.TERM_END_DATE, tws.window_column, tws.Total_Terms_Per_Year, mae.max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM term_window_stats AS tws JOIN max_avg_enrollment AS mae ON tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mae.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered, show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, subject ID, the term description, academic year, term start date, the maximum term end date for each row and the next two rows in order of subject offered key, and indicate whether the term status indicator is 'P' (past), 'C' (current), or 'F' (future), only for terms that are not the current term and have a material status key of 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each financial aid year and academic year where the term status is 'Previous', show the financial aid year, academic year, academic year description, department name, the number of terms in that year, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U'. For each financial aid year, include a grand total for all terms in the format of (financial aid year, null, null, null, total terms, null). For each academic year, also include a grand total across all departments in the format of (financial aid year, academic year, academic year description, null, total terms, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH RollupResults AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), YearTermCounts AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0), DeptVariation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_terms, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 20, show the activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year of the associated term, the IAP term description, and for each such activity, show the previous academic term code, previous term description, previous academic year, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for previous terms, and the previous academic year description, for all previous academic terms that share the same term code as the IAP activity. Order the results by activity title and previous academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH iap_activities AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE), previous_terms AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT * FROM inner_cte) SELECT iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_activities.window_column AS IAP_DENSE_RANK, iap_activities.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, previous_terms.TERM_CODE AS PREV_TERM_CODE, previous_terms.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, previous_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, previous_terms.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, previous_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM iap_activities JOIN previous_terms ON iap_activities.TERM_CODE = previous_terms.TERM_CODE ORDER BY iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, previous_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the difference between the number of enrolled students for each subject and the minimum number of enrolled students in its offering department, the academic year description (for non-current terms), and the deviation from the average number of enrolled students for that academic year. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_stats.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS avg_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.deviation_from_min_enrolled_students, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` WHERE TERM_STATUS target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH AcademicTermDetails AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), AcademicYearVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT atd.TERM_CODE, atd.TERM_PARAMETER, atd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atd.TERM_START_DATE, atd.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation FROM AcademicTermDetails AS atd JOIN AcademicYearVariation AS ayv ON atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atd.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CurrentTermSummary AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS atp JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), CurrentTermSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, csub.SUBJECT_TITLE, csub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, csub.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, csub.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, csub.window_column, csub.SUBJECT_ID FROM CurrentTermSummary AS cts JOIN CurrentTermSubjects AS csub ON cts.TERM_CODE = csub.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

DESC), TermInfo AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), DeptSubjects AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cco ON t0.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, t.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_PARAMETER, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.num_subjects FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TermInfo AS t ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DeptSubjects AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(d.num_subjects) FROM target_disjoint_workload.question: For academic terms where the term status indicator is 'P', show the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the academic year, the term start date, the average academic year in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for the corresponding academic year, and the total number of unique departments offering subjects in those terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), AcademicYearVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0), DepartmentCounts AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON t0.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation, dc.num_departments FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN AcademicYearVariation AS ayv ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DepartmentCounts AS dc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic term where the term status indicator is 'P', show the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the academic year, the term start date, and the average academic year in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date. Additionally, for the academic year of each such term, give the academic year description, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and for each such subject, show the subject code, subject number, and subject title, with the results ordered by term code and by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms AS pts JOIN AcademicYearStats AS ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH SubjectMaxUnits AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE), TermUnitStats AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE s.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT smu.SUBJECT_CODE, smu.SUBJECT_NUMBER, smu.SUBJECT_TITLE, smu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, smu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, smu.TERM_CODE, smu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, smu.TERM_START_DATE, smu.max_total_units_3rows, tus.TERM_PARAMETER, tus.avg_total_units, tus.total_units_variance, tus.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectMaxUnits AS smu JOIN TermUnitStats AS tus ON smu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DeptCostStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT LIKE '%Mathematics%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date, dcs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptCostStats AS dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME, CIP.VERSION FROM `CIP` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(VERSION) AS avg_version FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_version AS school_avg_version, CASE WHEN i.VERSION > s.avg_version * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VERSION' WHEN i.VERSION < s.avg_version * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VERSION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS version_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME

Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS a ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = a.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, a.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM) SELECT ic.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, ic.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, a.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS a ON ic.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = a.HASS_ATTRIBUTE ORDER BY ic.units_range DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics) where the maximum CIP program code among its courses is greater than 120000, what is the department name, the maximum CIP program code, the full department name, the department's phone number, and the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH hass_elective_counts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), max_cip_program AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT mcp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcp.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, mcp.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, hec.num_hass_elective_subjects FROM max_cip_program AS mcp LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON mcp.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN hass_elective_counts AS hec ON mcp.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hec.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE mcp.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 ORDER BY mcp.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each degree-granting department except Biology (Course 7), provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, the name of the school to which the department belongs, and the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.avg_enrolled_students, ic2.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic1.num_hass_elective_subjects FROM inner_cte2 AS ic2 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 AS ic1 ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a HASS attribute of 'HE', show the subject title, department name, HASS attribute description, and for each department, include a grand total of subjects in the format of (null, department name, null, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS t1 ON t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = t1.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = 'HE'), DepartmentTotals AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, NULL AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, dt.total_subjects FROM DepartmentTotals AS dt ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year that is classified as a HASS Elective, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, the number of units for the subject, the total number of subjects in the same department that are also HASS Electives, and indicate whether the subject has more units than the average number of units for HASS Electives in its department. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE_UNITS' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE_UNITS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNITS' END AS unit_comparison FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg_units AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department, what is the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form? List the department name and the count, and indicate whether the department is a 'TOP_PROVIDER' (at least 20 subjects), 'ACTIVE_PROVIDER' (at least 10 but less than 20 subjects), or 'LOW_PROVIDER' (less than 10 subjects). target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 20 THEN 'TOP_PROVIDER' WHEN COUNT(*) >= 10 THEN 'ACTIVE_PROVIDER' ELSE 'LOW_PROVIDER' END AS provider_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: List the subject codes and titles of all subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective') SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each HASS attribute, what is the maximum row number assigned to any subject offered in the academic year 2022 with that HASS attribute, where row numbers are assigned within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title? target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, t1.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS t1 ON t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = t1.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022) SELECT HASS_ATTRIBUTE, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, MAX(window_column) AS max_row_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HASS_ATTRIBUTE, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department, what is the highest number of units among all HASS Elective subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and which subject(s) have that number of units? target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective') SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND i.TOTAL_UNITS = m.max_units

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department in the 2022 academic year, list the department code, department name, the HASS Elective attribute description, the number of HASS Elective subjects offered in that department, and a grand total of HASS Elective subjects across all departments. For each department, include a grand total row in the format (null, null, null, total HASS Elective subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'), DepartmentHassCounts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, COUNT(*) AS num_hass_electives FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, num_hass_electives FROM DepartmentHassCounts ORDER BY CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, DEPARTMENT_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12, where the subject's department also offered at least one HASS Elective in 2022, provide the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, the row number within the department ordered by subject code, and the total number of HASS Electives in that department in 2022. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH HassElectives2022 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'), TwelveUnitSubjects2024 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.window_column, h.num_hass_electives_in_department FROM TwelveUnitSubjects2024 AS t2 JOIN HassElectives2022 AS h ON t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = h.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.window_column

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered in the 2024 academic year with total units equal to 12, show the department name, department code, subject code (2024), subject number (2024), subject title (2024), total units (2024), the row number within the department ordered by subject code, and for each such subject, also show the subject code (2022), subject number (2022), subject title (2022), total units (2022), and the total number of HASS Elective subjects in the same department offered in 2022, and calculate the ratio of the row number to the number of HASS Elective subjects in the department (rounded to two decimal places).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH HassElectives2022 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'), TwelveUnitSubjects2024 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE AS subject_code_2024, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS subject_number_2024, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2024, t2.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units_2024, t2.window_column, h1.SUBJECT_CODE AS subject_code_2022, h1.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS subject_number_2022, h1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2022, h1.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units_2022, h1.num_hass_electives_in_department, ROUND(t2.window_column / NULLIF(h1.num_hass_electives_in_department, 0), 2) AS window_to_hass_electives_ratio FROM TwelveUnitSubjects2024 AS t2 LEFT JOIN HassElectives2022 AS h1 ON t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = h1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.window_column, h1.SUBJECT_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: From the top 10 Mathematics (Course 18) subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog, display each subject's code, subject number, short title, total units, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year, have total units greater than zero, and are in the Mathematics department), and the most common course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION for that subject's code, along with the count of subjects with that description, ordered by total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE), geom_mean_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC), desc_rank_cte AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS desc_count, @rank := CASE WHEN @current_code = ic.SUBJECT_CODE THEN @rank + 1 ELSE 1 END AS `Rank`, @current_code := ic.SUBJECT_CODE FROM (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_code := '') AS vars, inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, desc_count DESC) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.min_total_units_by_dept, gmc.geometric_mean_total_units, drc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS Most_Common_Description, drc.desc_count AS Description_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN geom_mean_cte AS gmc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN desc_rank_cte AS drc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = drc.SUBJECT_CODE AND drc.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: For all departments whose names contain 'Mathematics', for each academic year and each department, what is the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are not variable units), including a grand total for all such departments in the format of (academic year, null, total statistics)? Additionally, for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the term description (not repeated if the same as the previous row), department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, as well as the school name and the total number of subjects in the department for that term. Present all results in a single table, with a column indicating whether the row is a department statistics row or a subject details row, and include all columns in the following order: result type, academic year, department name, average total units, variance of total units, term description, subject code, subject number, subject title, subject rank in department, school name, and subject count in department. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT 'Department_Statistics' AS result_type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.var_total_units, NULL AS term_description, NULL AS subject_code, NULL AS subject_number, NULL AS subject_title, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS school_name, NULL AS subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Subject_Details' AS result_type, NULL AS academic_year, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, s2.term_description, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery2 AS s2 ORDER BY result_type, academic_year, department_name, term_description, subject_code

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) and excluding subjects offered by the Department of Physics, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, the total number of lecture units, and the responsible faculty member's full name. Additionally, for the Mathematics department, include the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses for which a responsible faculty member is also a member of a Moira list, considering only courses offered this year. The results should display the subject ID, subject title, department name, number of enrolled students, lecture units, responsible faculty full name, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'), subq2 AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` INNER JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.LECTURE_UNITS, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of courses, average number of equivalent subjects, the school name, department phone number, and the number of distinct required or optional textbook materials used in that department and term. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, MIN(MEET_TIME) AS mintime, AVG(CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) END) AS avgeqisub FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS num_required_or_optional_materials FROM inner_cte AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS mat ON tbltmp.term = mat.TERM_CODE AND tbltmp.dept = mat.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and the rank within each school name group ordered by subject code, but only include those subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for their respective school. Additionally, for the Mathematics department, also show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), as well as the number of subjects that are Communication Intensive (i.e., have a non-null COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE), with these statistics included for each subject in the result. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM (SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT ccso.COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE IS NULL THEN ic.SUBJECT_CODE END) AS comm_intensive_subject_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY comm_intensive_subject_count DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.comm_intensive_subject_count FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, along with the department name, school name, the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the subject short title and subject description for each subject. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_CODE AS join_subject_code FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), math_dept_course_count AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, 'Mathematics' AS join_department_name FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, mdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdc.SCHOOL_NAME, mdc.num_courses, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN math_dept_course_count AS mdc JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) and excluding subjects offered by the Department of Physics, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, the number of enrolled students, the total number of lecture units, and, for each subject, indicate whether it is also offered as a joint subject with another department. Additionally, show the range and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered this year in the Mathematics department. List the results in order of subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'), MathDeptUnitStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND NOT TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, CASE WHEN NOT ccs.JOINT_SUBJECTS IS NULL AND TRIM(ccs.JOINT_SUBJECTS) <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_JOINT_SUBJECT, mds.total_units_range, mds.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MathDeptUnitStats AS mds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 departments by the number of non-repeatable-for-credit subjects offered in the fall term, list the department name, academic year, number of such subjects, subject code, subject title, number of enrolled students (for subjects with at least 5 enrolled students), material status key, ISBN, responsible faculty name, and the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, for subjects that meet both criteria. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.window_column

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year by a degree-granting department, specifically in the Department of Mathematics (Course 18) but not in the Department of Physics, and that is also printed in the bulletin and belongs to the Mathematics department, provide the subject ID, subject title, department name, number of enrolled students, total number of lecture units, name of the responsible faculty member, total units, and the number of such subjects per department, with the results ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics') SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON i.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, dept_counts.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.LECTURE_UNITS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.subject_count FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic year in the Mathematics department where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, the average total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term that are not variable units, the variance of these total units, and the maximum subject enrollment number for Mathematics subjects in the spring term. Show the results ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.num_unique_subjects, icte.min_total_units, mfall.avg_total_units, mfall.var_total_units, mspring.max_spring_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mfall ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mfall.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_spring_enrollment FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mspring ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mspring.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding Biology/Course 7), list the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and for each HGN code in the Political Science department, list the department name, HGN code, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units. Additionally, for each department, provide a grand total row with the department name, nulls for HGN code, max lecture units, and subject title, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in 2022. Indicate the source of each row as either 'DeptUnitsStats', 'PoliSciHGNStats', or 'DeptSubjectTotals'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC), PoliSciHGNStats AS (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2), DeptSubjectTotals AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_units, d.units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Source FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d UNION ALL SELECT p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'PoliSciHGNStats' AS Source FROM PoliSciHGNStats AS p UNION ALL SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, t.total_subjects, 'DeptSubjectTotals' AS Source FROM DeptSubjectTotals AS t) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department in the 2022 academic year, list the department code, department name, the HASS Elective attribute description, the number of HASS Elective subjects offered in that department, and a grand total of HASS Elective subjects across all departments. For each department, include a grand total row in the format (null, null, null, total HASS Elective subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'), DepartmentHassCounts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, COUNT(*) AS num_hass_electives FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, num_hass_electives FROM DepartmentHassCounts ORDER BY CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, DEPARTMENT_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: List, for each department that grants degrees (excluding Chemistry and Biology), the department code, department full name, school name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and the number of unique subjects offered by the department (considering only departments that offer more than 5 unique subjects). target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38') SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS access_level_window_row_number, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS avg_area_window FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_ROOM = s2.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR
