target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', provide the number of unique facility organization keys, the minimum organization unit ID, the most recent warehouse load date, the corresponding department code, and the department name. Also, include subtotals for each department long name (the corresponding department long name field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department long name field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department long name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_long) OVER (ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort) = dept_long THEN NULL ELSE dept_long END AS department_long_name, hier3_name, org_count, min_org_unit_id, max_load_date FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS hier3_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS hier3_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.min_org_unit_id, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS') SELECT s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name, s1.org_count, s1.min_org_unit_id, s1.max_load_date, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.department_long_name = s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND s1.hier3_name = s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AND s1.min_org_unit_id = s2.min_org_unit_id ORDER BY s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each assignable organization with a department code above 100000, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, the department name, the average number of sub-departments (where HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL is 'SUB DEPARTMENT') associated with the department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of sub-departments, and the top-level area name from the HR org hierarchy. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id, f.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY), dept_subdept_stats AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments, m.DLC_KEY FROM `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY) AS sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT m.DLC_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_subdept_stats AS d ON i.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each space unit and its associated organization, list the space unit name, organization name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null. Additionally, include the HR org unit title and HR org unit level for each HR org unit linked to the space unit. Do not repeat the space unit name if it is the same as the previous row. List the results ordered by the HR department code range (descending), then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) (descending), and then by HR org unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS su JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC), OrgStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC), CombinedStats AS (SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old, s.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN OrgStats AS o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(cs.SPACE_UNIT) OVER (ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) = cs.SPACE_UNIT THEN NULL ELSE cs.SPACE_UNIT END AS SPACE_UNIT, cs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cs.avg_hr_dept_code, cs.hr_dept_code_range, cs.hr_dept_code_variance, cs.avg_dept_code_old, cs.var_dept_code_old, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM CombinedStats AS cs JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON cs.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

Additionally, for each such result, show the corresponding HR organization unit title and the school/area name from the HR_ORG_UNIT table. Do not return any rounded answers.

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.total_max_enrollment, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each activity, list the activity title, enrollment type, and maximum enrollment, along with the category name and the category description, and show the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name. target_disjoint_workload.question: For IAP subjects in the "Mathematics" category, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the sponsor key, and assign row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. Also, show the total number of activities per enrollment type in the "Mathematics" category. Do not return any rounded answers.

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject category, provide the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, and the total number of activities in the category. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject category, provide the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, and also show the difference between the average and the variance for each category. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject category that had at least 5 activities in the 2021JA term, show the subject category key, the category name, the number of activities, the total maximum enrollment across those activities, and classify the category as 'HIGH_CAPACITY' if its total maximum enrollment is at least 20% greater than the average total maximum enrollment across all qualifying categories, 'LOW_CAPACITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_max_enrollment) AS avg_total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.activity_count, i.total_max_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_max_enrollment > a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.total_max_enrollment < a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject category, provide the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, and also include a grand total row for all categories in the format of (null, total average, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY CASE WHEN IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, var_max_enrollment DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject category name and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, what is the average fee and the total number of activities for each sponsor? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

target_disjoint_workload.question: From the top 10 IAP activities with the highest maximum enrollment, display each activity's title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, the category name, and the number of activities in that category, along with the dense rank of each activity within its category by maximum enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cat_stats.Category_Activity_Count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC) AS Category_Dense_Rank FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Category_Activity_Count FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS cat_stats ON ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = cat_stats.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: List the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title for activities in the "Mathematics" category (showing null for activities not in "Mathematics"). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH activity_category_dense_rank AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), math_enrollment_row_number AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.window_column AS dense_rank_within_category, m.window_column AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math FROM activity_category_dense_rank AS a LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_row_number AS m ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND a.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment of at least 20 and that is not cancelled, list the activity title, enrollment type, academic year description, term start date, and the total number of IAP subject activities per academic year, along with the subject category name, sponsor key, average fee, and total number of activities for each sponsor and category where the enrollment type matches and the maximum enrollment is greater than 10. The columns should be shown in the following order: activity title, enrollment type, academic year description, term start date, total number of IAP subject activities per academic year, subject category name, sponsor key, average fee, and total number of activities for each sponsor. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH ActivityStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE, t0.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CategorySponsorStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.TERM_START_DATE, a.Total_Activities, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, c.avg_fee, c.total_activities FROM ActivityStats AS a JOIN CategorySponsorStats AS c ON a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each previous academic term where the term start date matches the minimum academic term start date for a subject category and academic year with more than 10 maximum enrollment, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the subject category key, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum academic term start date, the normalized subjects per year rounded (number of unique subjects divided by the average calendar year), and for each such term, also list the number of unique subject IDs offered in that term and the earliest preregistration deadline among those subjects.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR), TermSubjectInfo AS (SELECT t.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_ids, MIN(i.PREREG_DEADLINE) AS earliest_prereg_deadline FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS i ON t.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(icte.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year, tsi.unique_subject_ids, tsi.earliest_prereg_deadline FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON icte.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date JOIN TermSubjectInfo AS tsi ON icte.TERM_CODE = tsi.TERM_CODE ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the activity title, enrollment type, term description, subject ID, and the sum of maximum enrollment within each academic year, but only include activities that are not cancelled and are part of multiple sessions. Order the results by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, t0.IS_CANCELLED, t0.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION = 'Y' ORDER BY ACTIVITY_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IAP subjects in the "Mathematics" category, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, activity description, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title, along with the academic year, department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, department phone number, and school name for each academic year and department where the IAP subject's term matches a department's fall term subject offering with more than 0 enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.window_column, inner_cte1.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON inner_cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inner_cte1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.department_phone, s2.school_name FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, term description, subject ID, and the earliest create date for each activity within each term description group. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.CREATE_DATE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID, MIN(CREATE_DATE) AS earliest_create_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, enrollment type, prerequisites, term code, term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum term start date over each term code group, and the total number of such activities per term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, term_counts.total_activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS term_counts ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = term_counts.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each person role and term, provide the person role name, term, the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for the activities they lead, considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a specified maximum enrollment. Include subtotals for each person role (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all person roles and terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the person role if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by person role and term. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, d.TERM_CODE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON` AS p JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(PERSON_ROLE) OVER (ORDER BY person_role_sort, term_sort) = PERSON_ROLE THEN NULL ELSE PERSON_ROLE END AS person_role, term, avg_max_enrollment, max_enrollment_range, max_enrollment_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE PERSON_ROLE END AS person_role_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, PERSON_ROLE, TERM_CODE, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY PERSON_ROLE, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY person_role_sort, term_sort

target_disjoint_workload.question: List all IAP subject activities with activity title, enrollment type, academic year description, term start date, and the total number of IAP subject activities per academic year for activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 20 and that are not cancelled, as well as for each subject category name and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, show the enrollment type, subject category name, sponsor key, average fee, and total number of activities for each sponsor. Indicate the source of each row as either 'IAP Activity' or 'Category Sponsor'. The columns should be: activity title, enrollment type, subject category name, sponsor key, average fee, total number of activities for sponsor, academic year description, term start date, total number of IAP subject activities per academic year, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, NULL AS IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, NULL AS IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, NULL AS avg_fee, NULL AS total_activities_sponsor, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.Total_Activities, 'IAP Activity' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, s2.avg_fee, s2.total_activities AS total_activities_sponsor, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS Total_Activities, 'Category Sponsor' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, avg_fee, total_activities_sponsor, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_START_DATE, Total_Activities, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ENROLLMENT_TYPE, Source, ACTIVITY_TITLE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department, for IAP activities in 2021 that had a maximum enrollment of at least 20, were not cancelled, and were associated with subjects offered by that department, list the department name, the activity's category name (do not repeat the category name if it is the same as the previous row), the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, the number of activities in that category, and the total number of such activities for the department. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.SESSION_TITLE, i.SESSION_LOCATION, i.SESSION_DATE, i.SESSION_START_TIME, i.SESSION_END_TIME, i.min_start_time_per_location, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 50 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.MAX_ENROLLMENT < 25 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CAPACITY' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t0 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON i.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ORDER BY i.SESSION_LOCATION

target_disjoint_workload.question: Show the activity titles, enrollment types, maximum enrollments, session titles, session locations, session dates, session start and end times, the minimum session start time per session location, the dense rank (considering the current and 2 preceding rows) ordered by academic year, and the term description for IAP subject activities in term '2021JA' that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of at least 20, ordered by session location. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte.SESSION_TITLE, cte.SESSION_LOCATION, cte.SESSION_DATE, cte.SESSION_START_TIME, cte.SESSION_END_TIME, cte.min_start_time_per_location, dr.window_column, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) AS dr ON cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = dr.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND cte.TERM_CODE = dr.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cte.SESSION_LOCATION

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE, SPONSOR_NAME, max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE, NULL AS SPONSOR_NAME, VARIANCE(max_enrollment_variance) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY SPONSOR_TYPE, SPONSOR_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY) SELECT i.SPONSOR_TYPE, i.SPONSOR_NAME, i.max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE) AS t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY i.max_enrollment_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each sponsor, provide the sponsor name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, and also display the sponsor type. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE) SELECT icte.SPONSOR_NAME, icte.SPONSOR_TYPE, icte.avg_max_enrollment, icte.var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte ORDER BY icte.avg_max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each sponsor whose average maximum enrollment for their IAP activities is among the top 5 highest, provide the sponsor name, sponsor type, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, and for each department associated with that sponsor in 2021 (for IAP activities that were not cancelled), provide the department name and the highest maximum enrollment among those activities. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH SponsorStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE) SELECT icte.SPONSOR_NAME, icte.SPONSOR_TYPE, icte.avg_max_enrollment, icte.var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte ORDER BY icte.avg_max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5), DeptMaxEnroll AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_iap_activities_2021 FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY) SELECT ss.SPONSOR_NAME, ss.SPONSOR_TYPE, ss.avg_max_enrollment, ss.var_max_enrollment, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.highest_max_enrollment FROM SponsorStats AS ss JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON ss.SPONSOR_NAME = s.SPONSOR_NAME AND ss.SPONSOR_TYPE = s.SPONSOR_TYPE JOIN DeptMaxEnroll AS dme ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = dme.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each sponsor and each academic year and department, provide the sponsor name, sponsor type, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, the academic year, the department name, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms (including grand totals for all departments as department name null), where the sponsor has at least one IAP activity in that academic year. List the sponsor name, sponsor type, average maximum enrollment, variance of maximum enrollment, academic year, department name, average total units, and variance of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH SponsorEnrollmentStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC), DepartmentUnitsStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, SUM(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(var_total_units) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.avg_max_enrollment, s.var_max_enrollment, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.var_total_units FROM SponsorEnrollmentStats AS s JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS iss ON s.SPONSOR_NAME = iss.SPONSOR_NAME AND s.SPONSOR_TYPE = iss.SPONSOR_TYPE JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd ON iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON isd.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS d ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.SPONSOR_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each sponsor and each academic year and department, provide the sponsor name, sponsor type, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, and the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms in that academic year and department, including grand totals for all departments (where department name is null). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH sponsor_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC), dept_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, SUM(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(var_total_units) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.avg_max_enrollment, s.var_max_enrollment, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.var_total_units FROM sponsor_stats AS s JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS iss ON s.SPONSOR_NAME = iss.SPONSOR_NAME AND s.SPONSOR_TYPE = iss.SPONSOR_TYPE JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd ON iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN dept_units_stats AS d ON at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), the department name, and the total number of such library subjects offered per department in that year, and for each sponsor type, what is the sponsor type, sponsor name, and the variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities sponsored by that sponsor (considering only activities that are not cancelled and where the sponsor's type has at least one activity with a non-null maximum enrollment)? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH academic_year_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), sponsor_type_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY) SELECT i.SPONSOR_TYPE, i.SPONSOR_NAME, i.max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE) AS t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.enrolled_students_variance, ayv.department_name, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered, stv.SPONSOR_TYPE, stv.SPONSOR_NAME, stv.max_enrollment_variance FROM academic_year_variance AS ayv CROSS JOIN sponsor_type_variance AS stv ORDER BY ayv.enrolled_students_variance DESC, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, stv.max_enrollment_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department, academic year, activity title, and sponsor name where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the maximum enrollment for the activity is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, activity title, sponsor name, number of unique activities, minimum fee, and the sponsor type. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME), TermJoin AS (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN TermJoin AS tj ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tj.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON tj.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND tj.SPONSOR_NAME = ass.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.min_fee, s.SPONSOR_TYPE FROM inner_cte JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME = s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, and for each activity title and sponsor name where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10 and the activity occurs in the same academic year, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, activity title, sponsor name, number of unique activities, minimum fee, and the number of unique sponsor types for those activities, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPONSOR_TYPE) AS sponsor_type_count, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee, ass.sponsor_type_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ass.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, and for each activity title and sponsor name where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10 and the activity occurs in the same academic year, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, activity title, sponsor name, number of unique activities, and minimum fee, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee FROM DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON t.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE WHERE d.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE LIMIT 1) ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: Among all instructors who have taught courses in the "18 - Mathematics" department and in the "Hayden" unit, list each instructor's MIT ID, the total number of distinct courses they have taught in that department and unit, and their dense rank among all such instructors based on the number of courses taught (with ties sharing the same rank), ordered from most to least courses taught. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.MIT_ID, t0.COURSE_NAME FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS t0 JOIN `SE_PERSON` AS t1 ON t0.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT = '18 - Mathematics' AND t0.UNIT = 'Hayden') SELECT icte.MIT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) AS Num_Courses_Taught, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) DESC) AS Instructor_Rank FROM inner_cte AS icte GROUP BY icte.MIT_ID ORDER BY Num_Courses_Taught DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each term and department, what is the term, department, and the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department and term where the material status is 'U'? Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

target_disjoint_workload.question: From the top 10 departments with the highest variance of reserve catalog keys for courses with material status 'U', display each department's name, the variance of reserve catalog keys, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those library subjects, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH dept_catalog_var AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), dept_students_var AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT, dcv.catalog_key_variance, dsv.library_students_variance, dsv.library_students_stddev FROM dept_catalog_var AS dcv JOIN dept_students_var AS dsv ON dcv.DEPARTMENT = dsv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dcv.catalog_key_variance DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), YearDeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_total_units, dcv.catalog_key_variance FROM YearDeptSubjectStats AS yds JOIN DeptCatalogVariance AS dcv ON yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcv.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', as well as the range and variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department? Please provide the department name, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), catalog key range, and catalog key variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DeptCatalogKeyStats AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, MAX(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) - MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_range, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_range DESC) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dcks.catalog_key_range, dcks.catalog_key_variance FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus JOIN DeptCatalogKeyStats AS dcks ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcks.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, display the department name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', the subject code, subject number, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH dept_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), subject_window AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column FROM subject_window AS sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dv.catalog_key_variance DESC, sw.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', list the department name, the average of the total units for subjects, the variance of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, the range and variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department, and calculate the average total units divided by the catalog key range (rounded), ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DeptTotalUnits AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DeptCatalogKeyStats AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, MAX(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) - MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_range, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_range DESC) SELECT dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtu.avg_total_units, dtu.total_units_variance, dtu.total_units_stddev, dcks.catalog_key_range, dcks.catalog_key_variance, ROUND(dtu.avg_total_units / NULLIF(dcks.catalog_key_range, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_catalog_key_range FROM DeptTotalUnits AS dtu JOIN DeptCatalogKeyStats AS dcks ON dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcks.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY avg_units_per_catalog_key_range DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: List the name of each department, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department (if available), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least 5 different materials assigned in term '2013FA' (if available), and the reason for inclusion ('CatalogVariance' for catalog key variance and 'EnrolledStddev' for enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), DeptEnrolledStddev AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC), CombinedDepts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT AS DEPT_NAME, catalog_key_variance, NULL AS enrolled_stddev, 'CatalogVariance' AS Reason FROM DeptCatalogVariance UNION ALL SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, NULL AS catalog_key_variance, enrolled_stddev, 'EnrolledStddev' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrolledStddev) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPT_NAME

Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH department_catalog_key_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), department_enrolled_stddev AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC) SELECT dckv.DEPARTMENT, dckv.catalog_key_variance, desd.enrolled_stddev FROM department_catalog_key_variance AS dckv JOIN department_enrolled_stddev AS desd ON dckv.DEPARTMENT = desd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic year and department that has a non-null variance of reserve catalog keys for courses with material status 'U' in any term, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, the average of total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in regular terms. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance, term_sort FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DepartmentsWithHighVariance AS (SELECT DISTINCT dept FROM Subquery1 WHERE NOT catalog_key_variance IS NULL) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department that offers at least one subject in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, display the department name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', the number of such subjects offered, and the average subject enrollment number for those subjects, but only include departments where the average subject enrollment number for these subjects is greater than the overall average subject enrollment number for all subjects offered in 2022 with 12 units. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), subject_window AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects, AVG(sw.window_column) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM subject_window AS sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, catalog_key_variance, num_subjects, avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_subject_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) ORDER BY avg_subject_enrollment DESC, catalog_key_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each library material status, what is the count of reserve catalog items for term code '2009SP', and how does this count compare to the average count across all statuses? Indicate whether each status is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 10% greater than average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 10% less than average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, inner_cte.reserve_count, avg_stats.avg_count, CASE WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count > avg_stats.avg_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count < avg_stats.avg_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS status_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(reserve_count) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.reserve_count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH MaterialStatusReserveCounts AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE, SUM(reserve_count) AS reserve_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(reserve_count) > 0 ORDER BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE), DepartmentHighestAvgUnits AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC) SELECT msr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, msr.TERM_CODE, msr.reserve_count, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dhu.highest_avg_total_units FROM MaterialStatusReserveCounts AS msr LEFT JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON msr.TERM_CODE = lrmd.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN DepartmentHighestAvgUnits AS dhu ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dhu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE NOT msr.TERM_CODE IS NULL ORDER BY msr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, msr.TERM_CODE, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME
