GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_enrolled, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the cluster type description and the HGN code description for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, department name, course description, and the difference between the total units and lecture units for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.LECTURE_UNITS FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, (TOTAL_UNITS - LECTURE_UNITS) AS units_minus_lecture FROM inner_cte

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject title offered in the term with code '2012SU' by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, show the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, academic year, term description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for that subject (considering only subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department and with more than 5 offerings), and the average number of enrolled students for that subject across all terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubjectStddev AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC), SubjectWindow AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog') SELECT sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.SUBJECT_ID, sw.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.window_column, ss.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectWindow AS sw JOIN SubjectStddev AS ss ON sw.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = so.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject that is either offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' (showing the subject title, subject key, department name, and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, with the reason 'Cluster S Dense Rank'), or is offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (showing the subject title, subject key, department name, the number of subject offerings, and the total number of units for those offerings, with the reason 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment'), also include the total number of lab units for each subject (if available). For each result, include the subject title, subject key, department name, offering count, total units, total lab units, window column, and the reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'), Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS offering_count, NULL AS total_units, SUM(t3.LAB_UNITS) AS total_lab_units, s.window_column, 'Cluster S Dense Rank' AS Reason FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON s.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t3 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t3.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column), Subquery2 AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, SUM(ss.LAB_UNITS) AS total_lab_units, NULL AS window_column, 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment' AS Reason FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.offering_count, s1.total_units, s1.total_lab_units, s1.window_column, s1.Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.offering_count, s2.total_units, s2.total_lab_units, s2.window_column, s2.Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME, offering_count, total_units, total_lab_units, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the number of distinct subjects offered, and for each subject offered in 2022 with a total of 12 units in Mathematics, the subject title, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, but only include those records where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for their HGN code group? Present the results ordered by variance of total units (descending) and then by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` GROUP BY HGN_CODE) AS a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_units_variance, subq1.num_subjects_offered, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.join_department_name ORDER BY subq1.total_units_variance DESC, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: List the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the corresponding subject code and subject title for each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, s.COURSE_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.COURSE_NUMBER

target_disjoint_workload.question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each of these, also provide the number of unique library subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, considering only departments and course numbers where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2. Show the subject title, offer department name, term description, window column, subject count, and minimum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.COURSE_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'), DeptCourseLibraryStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA AS s JOIN DeptCourseLibraryStats AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school code, school name, department code, school name from department, department phone number, and the highest running sum of total units for any subject within that school in the 2019FA term (where the subject has more than 1 total unit). Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte1.window_column, inner_cte1.SCHOOL_CODE, inner_cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME_DEPT, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1), cte2 AS (SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte1.window_column, cte1.SCHOOL_CODE, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME_DEPT, cte1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, cte2.highest_running_sum_total_units FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.SCHOOL_CODE = cte2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term that have a total of 1 unit and also have a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from the summary, the course number from the offered table, the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the summary, the offer department name from the offered summary, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject title from the summary, the subject title from SUBJECT_OFFERED, the offer department name from SUBJECT_OFFERED, the total units from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from SUBJECT_OFFERED. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S') SELECT s1.summary_subject_title, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.offered_summary_subject_title, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.window_column AS summary_window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_subject_title, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS offered_offer_dept_name, s2.TOTAL_UNITS AS offered_total_units, s2.window_column AS offered_window_column FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit, offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, show the department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for any such subject in each department, subject ID, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID, along with, for courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, the course, course description, school name, the rank of each course within its department ordered by course, and also include the department's full name from the department table. Show all these columns in the order: department name, max enrollment, subject ID, subject title, term description, subject rank in department, course, course description, school name, course rank in department, department full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_enrollment, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.window_column AS course_rank_in_dept, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.COURSE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject that is both offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA' and is in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, the name of the responsible faculty member for each subject, the academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the term description, and the term start date, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t1 INNER JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS sum_lecture_units_by_grade_type, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS subject_rank_within_academic_year, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2019SP", show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term description, the total units for the subject, the average total units within each subject group, the offering department name, the school name, and the number of unique subject titles with materials offered in regular academic terms for the corresponding department and school. Do not repeat the subject title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the number of enrolled students and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subject_offered_2019sp AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP'), subject_titles_by_dept_school AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title_count FROM (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') AS ic GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(so.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = so.SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE so.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.TOTAL_UNITS, so.avg_total_units, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, stds.subject_title_count FROM subject_offered_2019sp AS so LEFT JOIN subject_titles_by_dept_school AS stds ON so.dept_name = stds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND so.school_name = stds.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject title and department name where the total units are greater than 3, give the number of offered sections, the minimum number of enrolled students, and the average lab units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS section_count, MIN(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 3 GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.section_count, inner_cte.min_enrolled, AVG(ss.LAB_UNITS) AS avg_lab_units FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.section_count, inner_cte.min_enrolled

target_disjoint_workload.question: How many subjects offered in 2012 as part of the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, in either the Chemistry or Biology departments, had a total of more than 1 unit? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_2012_subjects FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')

target_disjoint_workload.question: How many subjects offered by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program in 2012 had more than 5 enrolled students and were offered by the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_2012_subjects FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2012' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

target_disjoint_workload.question: How many subjects offered in 2012 had more than 5 enrolled students, belonged to the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program department, and were either in the Chemistry or Biology department? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, the school name, department phone number, and the highest running sum of total units for any subject within that school in the 2019FA term (where the subject has more than 1 total unit). Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column AS min_num_enrolled_students_per_subject_code, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.highest_running_sum_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_CODE = s2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each degree-granting department except Political Science (Course 17), show the department name, the number of unique student years in that department, each student year, the number of students, and the average, range, and variance of the number of students per student year in that department. Also, for the top 10 subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit, offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, show the department name, subject ID, subject title, term description, the rank of each subject within its department (ordered by subject ID), and the number of enrolled students for each subject. The results are combined in a single list, with columns: department name, number of unique student years, student year, number of students, average number of students per year, range of students per year, variance of students per year, subject ID, subject title, term description, subject rank in department, and number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS num_student_years, AVG(num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(num_students) - MIN(num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_student_years, ic.STUDENT_YEAR, ic.num_students, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_student_years, s1.STUDENT_YEAR, s1.num_students, s1.avg_students_per_year, s1.range_students_per_year, s1.var_students_per_year, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_student_years, NULL AS STUDENT_YEAR, NULL AS num_students, NULL AS avg_students_per_year, NULL AS range_students_per_year, NULL AS var_students_per_year, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, STUDENT_YEAR

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit, offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department, show the department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for any such subject in the department, subject ID, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID, and for courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, show the course, course description, school name, the rank of each course within its department ordered by course, and also include the department's full name from the department table, for each combination where the department name matches, listing the columns in the following order: department name, maximum enrollment, subject ID, subject title, term description, subject rank in department, course, course description, school name, course rank in department, and department full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), subq1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.COURSE, inner_cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_enrollment, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.COURSE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject category and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, provide the number of activities, the earliest start date of the corresponding academic term, and the latest end date of the corresponding academic term. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic term where the term status is 'Previous', show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, and also include the academic year and academic year description for each term. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, inner_cte.DAY_OF_WEEK, inner_cte.window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each fiscal period, what is the fiscal period description, the variance of the calendar year for all days in that period where the academic year is not null, and whether the variance is 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 20% greater than the average variance across all periods), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD, TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, VARIANCE(TIME_DAY.CALENDAR_YEAR) AS calendar_year_variance FROM `TIME_MONTH` JOIN `TIME_DAY` ON TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD = TIME_DAY.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE NOT TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL GROUP BY TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD, TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_PERIOD, inner_cte.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.calendar_year_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.calendar_year_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.calendar_year_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(calendar_year_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.calendar_year_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, and the fiscal year of the calendar date, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For tip details where the material status key is 'RQ' and for IAP subject activities that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the tip subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term description, academic year, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by academic year (as tip_window_avg_record_count), the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, academic term description from the time day table, term start date from the academic terms table, the minimum maximum enrollment value over each term code group (as iap_min_max_enrollment), and the academic year description from the academic terms table, ordered by academic year and IAP term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), IAPActivities AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10) SELECT icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.window_column AS tip_window_avg_record_count, ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ia.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.window_column AS iap_min_max_enrollment, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN IAPActivities AS ia ON icte.TERM_CODE = ia.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON icte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ia.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, term description, term start date, calendar date, and the day of the week, and assign row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t2.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t2.DAY_OF_WEEK, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t2 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t2.CALENDAR_DATE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject category and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, provide the number of activities, the earliest start date of the corresponding academic term, and the latest end date of the corresponding academic term. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date

target_disjoint_workload.question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, and the day of the week, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.DAY_OF_WEEK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic term with status 'Previous' and for each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the subject category key, academic year, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum academic term start date, where the academic year and minimum term start date match between the term and the subject category. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TermWindowStats AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT tws.TERM_CODE, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.CALENDAR_DATE, tws.DAY_OF_WEEK, tws.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date FROM TermWindowStats AS tws JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON tws.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date ORDER BY tws.TERM_START_DATE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the term start date, calendar date, day of week, and the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, but only for academic terms where the term status is 'Previous'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT m.COURSE_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.window_column AS math_window_column, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.CALENDAR_DATE, p.DAY_OF_WEEK, p.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column FROM MathCourses AS m JOIN PreviousTerms AS p ON m.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, TERM_START_DATE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic term with status 'Previous' where the term start date is the minimum start date of the term for a department and academic year in which the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the department name, the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the term, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT pt.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.TERM_START_DATE, pt.CALENDAR_DATE, pt.DAY_OF_WEEK, pt.window_column, dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_term_start_date FROM PreviousTerms AS pt JOIN DeptSubjectStats AS dss ON pt.TERM_START_DATE = dss.min_term_start_date ORDER BY pt.TERM_START_DATE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each previous academic term where the term start date matches the minimum academic term start date for a subject category and academic year with more than 10 maximum enrollment, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the subject category key, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum academic term start date, and calculate the normalized subjects per year rounded (number of unique subjects divided by the average calendar year).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TermInfo AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ti.TERM_CODE, ti.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ti.TERM_START_DATE, ti.CALENDAR_DATE, ti.DAY_OF_WEEK, ti.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(ti.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year FROM TermInfo AS ti JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON ti.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For fiscal quarters in the year 2026, show the fiscal year, fiscal quarter code, quarter start date, calendar year, calendar period description, calendar month name, the average calendar month (as a number) in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the fiscal period, and indicate whether the current calendar month is above, below, or at the window average. Order by the fiscal year. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.FISCAL_YEAR, t0.FY_QUARTER_CODE, t0.QUARTER_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_YEAR, t1.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH, AVG(t1.CALENDAR_MONTH) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FISCAL_PERIOD ORDER BY t0.FISCAL_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg FROM `TIME_QUARTER` AS t0 JOIN `TIME_MONTH` AS t1 ON t0.FISCAL_YEAR = t1.FISCAL_YEAR WHERE t0.FISCAL_YEAR = 2026) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.FY_QUARTER_CODE, inner_cte.QUARTER_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_YEAR, inner_cte.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, inner_cte.window_avg, CASE WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH > inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH < inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AT_AVERAGE' END AS month_vs_window FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each fiscal year, what is the minimum calendar month and the sum of calendar years from TIME_MONTH for months that have at least one corresponding day in TIME_DAY with the academic term code '2020FA'? Show only fiscal years where such months exist. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(tm.CALENDAR_MONTH) AS min_calendar_month, SUM(tm.CALENDAR_YEAR) AS total_calendar_years, tm.FISCAL_YEAR FROM `TIME_MONTH` AS tm JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS td ON tm.FISCAL_PERIOD = td.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = '2020FA' GROUP BY tm.FISCAL_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.min_calendar_month, inner_cte.total_calendar_years FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each fiscal period, what is the fiscal period description, the variance of the calendar year for all days in that period where the academic year is not null, and whether the variance is 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 20% greater than the average variance across all periods), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD, TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, VARIANCE(TIME_DAY.CALENDAR_YEAR) AS calendar_year_variance FROM `TIME_MONTH` JOIN `TIME_DAY` ON TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD = TIME_DAY.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE NOT TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL GROUP BY TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD, TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_PERIOD, inner_cte.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.calendar_year_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.calendar_year_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.calendar_year_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(calendar_year_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.calendar_year_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic term code, what is the minimum calendar month and the sum of calendar years from TIME_MONTH for months that are in the fiscal year 2020 and have a corresponding day in TIME_DAY with that academic term code? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(tm.CALENDAR_MONTH) AS min_calendar_month, SUM(tm.CALENDAR_YEAR) AS total_calendar_years, td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE FROM `TIME_MONTH` AS tm JOIN `TIME_DAY` AS td ON tm.FISCAL_PERIOD = td.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE tm.FISCAL_YEAR = 2020 GROUP BY td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE) SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE, min_calendar_month, total_calendar_years FROM inner_cte

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each fiscal year and fiscal quarter, what is the fiscal year, the fiscal quarter code, and the geometric mean of the calendar month numbers for months where the calendar month is greater than the average calendar month number for that fiscal year and quarter? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT TIME_QUARTER.FISCAL_YEAR, TIME_QUARTER.FY_QUARTER_CODE, TIME_MONTH.CALENDAR_MONTH FROM `TIME_QUARTER` JOIN `TIME_MONTH` ON TIME_QUARTER.FISCAL_YEAR = TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_YEAR WHERE TIME_MONTH.CALENDAR_MONTH > 0), avg_months AS (SELECT FISCAL_YEAR, FY_QUARTER_CODE, AVG(CALENDAR_MONTH) AS avg_calendar_month FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FISCAL_YEAR, FY_QUARTER_CODE) SELECT i.FISCAL_YEAR, i.FY_QUARTER_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(i.CALENDAR_MONTH))) AS geometric_mean_calendar_month FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_months AS a ON i.FISCAL_YEAR = a.FISCAL_YEAR AND i.FY_QUARTER_CODE = a.FY_QUARTER_CODE WHERE i.CALENDAR_MONTH > a.avg_calendar_month GROUP BY i.FISCAL_YEAR, i.FY_QUARTER_CODE ORDER BY geometric_mean_calendar_month DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For fiscal quarters in the year 2026, show the fiscal year, fiscal quarter code, quarter start date, calendar year, calendar period description, calendar month name, the average calendar month (as a number) in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the fiscal period, and indicate whether the current calendar month is above, below, or at the window average. Order by the fiscal year. Do not return any rounded answers.

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each fiscal year and fiscal quarter, what is the fiscal year, the fiscal quarter code, and the geometric mean of the calendar month numbers for months where the calendar month is greater than the average calendar month number for that fiscal year and quarter? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT TIME_QUARTER.FISCAL_YEAR, TIME_QUARTER.FY_QUARTER_CODE, TIME_MONTH.CALENDAR_MONTH FROM `TIME_QUARTER` JOIN `TIME_MONTH` ON TIME_QUARTER.FISCAL_YEAR = TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_YEAR WHERE TIME_MONTH.CALENDAR_MONTH > 0), avg_months AS (SELECT FISCAL_YEAR, FY_QUARTER_CODE, AVG(CALENDAR_MONTH) AS avg_calendar_month FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FISCAL_YEAR, FY_QUARTER_CODE) SELECT i.FISCAL_YEAR, i.FY_QUARTER_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(i.CALENDAR_MONTH))) AS geometric_mean_calendar_month FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_months AS a ON i.FISCAL_YEAR = a.FISCAL_YEAR AND i.FY_QUARTER_CODE = a.FY_QUARTER_CODE WHERE i.CALENDAR_MONTH > a.avg_calendar_month GROUP BY i.FISCAL_YEAR, i.FY_QUARTER_CODE ORDER BY geometric_mean_calendar_month DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, and for each associated course material detail, provide the material status key, subject ID, ISBN, material key, the course number description, the offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key. List the results ordered by subject title and material key. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH SubjectStats AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), MaterialStats AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.avg_academic_year, m.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.SUBJECT_ID, m.ISBN, m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, m.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, m.max_num_enrolled_students FROM SubjectStats AS s JOIN MaterialStats AS m ON s.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = m.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject that has a library material status of 'U' and a tip material status of 'RQ', what is the minimum library material status key, the total record count, and the most recent warehouse load date from both the library reserve and tip detail tables? target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lrmd.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records, MAX(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_library_warehouse_date, MAX(td.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_tip_warehouse_date FROM inner_cte JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records ORDER BY inner_cte.total_records DESC

a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT s1.academic_year, s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.material_count, s1.min_term_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.units_deviation FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.academic_year, s1.min_term_code

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each material information source, list the material information source, the total number of records for materials published after 2010 with a new shelf price greater than 10, and the average used shelf price for those materials, but only include sources where the total number of records is greater than 0 and the average used shelf price is above 20. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.PUBLISHER, i.material_count, i.min_used_price, s.avg_new_shelf_price AS benchmark_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.min_used_price < s.avg_new_shelf_price * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_USED_PRICE' WHEN i.min_used_price > s.avg_new_shelf_price * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_USED_PRICE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USED_PRICE' END AS used_price_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) AS s ON i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AND i.PUBLISHER = s.PUBLISHER

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each material information source, provide the material information source, the total number of records for materials published after 2010 and with a new shelf price greater than 10, the average new shelf price for those materials as a benchmark, and categorize the total records as 'HIGH_RECORDS' if at least 20% greater than the benchmark record count across all sources, 'LOW_RECORDS' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE HAVING SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) > 0), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE), overall_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_records) AS avg_total_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, i.total_records, b.avg_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.total_records > ob.avg_total_records * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_RECORDS' WHEN i.total_records < ob.avg_total_records * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_RECORDS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS records_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN benchmark_cte AS b ON i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = b.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS ob

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH MaterialStats AS (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price, d.TERM_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, d.TERM_CODE), DepartmentUnits AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, c.TERM_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TERM_CODE) SELECT ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.PUBLISHER, ms.material_count, ms.min_used_price, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance FROM MaterialStats AS ms JOIN DepartmentUnits AS du ON ms.TERM_CODE = du.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte), Subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_stats.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS avg_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.min_record_count, s1.total_new_shelf_price, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
