target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, the subject title, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL, and the total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL for each subject (where the material has a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN'), ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, s2.min_record_count, s2.total_new_shelf_price FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered in the term 2013FA, list the subject offered key, the subject ID, the number of materials assigned, the total new shelf price of those materials (considering only materials with a new shelf price greater than 10), and the average used shelf price of those materials. Do not repeat the subject offered key if it is the same as the previous row. Include subtotals for each subject ID (the corresponding subject offered key field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all subjects (the corresponding subject offered key field is 'TOTAL'). Sort the table by subject ID and subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subject_offered_key) OVER (ORDER BY subject_id_sort, subject_offered_key_sort) = subject_offered_key THEN NULL ELSE subject_offered_key END AS subject_offered_key, subject_id, material_count, total_new_shelf_price, avg_used_shelf_price FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS subject_offered_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS subject_offered_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SUBJECT_ID END AS subject_id_sort, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY subject_id_sort, subject_offered_key_sort

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department that is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18) and where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms exceeds the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such departments, list the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, and the highest number of materials for any single material status among its courses (considering only courses that have materials). The results should be ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH cv_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), avg_cv AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_cv AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv), materials_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation, materials_cte.highest_material_count_for_status FROM cv_cte JOIN materials_cte ON cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = materials_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department that is degree-granting and not the Political Science department, and only considering subjects offered by the School of Engineering in the term '2016SP', what are the department name, the variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (for departments where this variance is greater than the average variance across all such departments), and the highest number of materials for any single material status among its courses (considering only courses that have materials)? List the department name, the enrolled students variance, and the highest material count for a status, in that order, sorted by enrolled students variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), material_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte AS evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte AS mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department, what are the top 10 material statuses by the number of materials for courses in that department, including the material status description and the count of materials for each status, considering only courses with materials, and only include departments where the total number of materials is greater than the average number of materials across all departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) SELECT department_name, material_status_description, material_count FROM (SELECT department_name, material_status_description, material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_name ORDER BY material_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 10 AND department_name IN (SELECT department_name FROM (SELECT department_name, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name) AS dept_totals WHERE total_materials > (SELECT AVG(total_materials) FROM (SELECT department_name, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name) AS all_depts)) ORDER BY department_name, material_count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 material statuses by the number of materials, what is the material status description, the count of materials for each status, the associated library material status, and the count of reserve catalog items for each library material status for term code '2009SP'? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TopMaterialStatuses AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), ReserveCounts AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC) SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, rc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, rc.reserve_count FROM TopMaterialStatuses AS tms JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms2 ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS = tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = lrmd.TERM_CODE JOIN ReserveCounts AS rc ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = rc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 material statuses by the number of materials, what is the corresponding library material status and the number of reserve catalog items for term code '2009SP' for each? List the material status, the count of materials, the library material status, and the count of reserve catalog items, ordered by the material count and then by the reserve count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TopMaterialStatuses AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), LibraryReserveCounts AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC) SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count FROM TopMaterialStatuses AS tms JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms2 ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms ON tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS JOIN LibraryReserveCounts AS lrc ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY tms.material_count DESC, lrc.reserve_count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 material statuses by number of materials, what are the corresponding library material statuses and their reserve catalog item counts for term code '2009SP'? List the material status, the material count, the library material status, and the reserve catalog item count, ordered by material count and then reserve catalog item count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH TopMaterialStatuses AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC) SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count FROM TopMaterialStatuses AS tms JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus AS lms ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count ORDER BY tms.material_count DESC, lms.reserve_count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 material statuses by the number of materials, show the material status description, the count of materials for each status, the associated library material status, and the count of reserve catalog items for term code '2009SP', ordered by the material count and then by the reserve count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH MaterialStatusCounts AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), LibraryReserveCounts AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS lms JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC) SELECT msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, msc.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count FROM MaterialStatusCounts AS msc JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN LibraryReserveCounts AS lrc ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, msc.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count ORDER BY msc.material_count DESC, lrc.reserve_count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: What are the top 10 material statuses by the number of materials for courses in the Biology department, including the material status description and the count of materials for each status, considering only courses with materials? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Biology' AND (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each department in the Engineering or Science schools with more than 20 reserved library materials for courses that have materials, list the department name, the total number of reserved library materials, the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key, and calculate the reserved materials per maximum enrolled students (rounded), ordering the results by reserved materials per maximum enrolled students in descending order.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 20) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students, ROUND(ic.total_reserved_materials / NULLIF(cs.max_enrolled_students, 0), 2) AS reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') AS cs ON ic.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), and only including courses that have course materials, show the subject title, offering department name, school name, department full name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department name. Additionally, for the same department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, but only include departments other than 'Mathematics' (Course 18). Also, for each of these departments, show the total number of courses offered by the department in the '2019FA' term that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials. Present the subject title, offering department name, school name, department full name, windowed minimum enrolled students, department name, average number of unique subject codes, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of unique subject codes, and the total number of such courses, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), course_counts AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS cd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.avg_subject_codes, scs.stddev_subject_codes, cc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN subject_code_stats AS scs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN course_counts AS cc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, scs.avg_subject_codes DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID. For each academic year, also show the academic year and academic year description and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have more than 0 total units and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P'. Additionally, for each Chemistry subject in '2014FA', show the number of TIP materials associated with it, and for each academic year, show the average number of TIP materials per Chemistry subject in '2014FA'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'), math_units_variation AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), chem_tip_materials AS (SELECT t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t LEFT JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON t.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AND t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID), chem_subjects_with_materials AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.window_column, i.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID, COALESCE(m.num_tip_materials, 0) AS num_tip_materials FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' LEFT JOIN chem_tip_materials AS m ON t.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = m.SUBJECT_ID), avg_materials_per_year AS (SELECT mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(csm.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials_per_chem_subject FROM math_units_variation AS mv CROSS JOIN chem_subjects_with_materials AS csm GROUP BY mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT csm.SUBJECT_TITLE, csm.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, csm.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, csm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, csm.window_column, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mv.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, csm.num_tip_materials, avgm.avg_tip_materials_per_chem_subject FROM chem_subjects_with_materials AS csm CROSS JOIN math_units_variation AS mv LEFT JOIN avg_materials_per_year AS avgm ON mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avgm.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avgm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group. Additionally, for the department offering the subject, show the department name, the range of enrolled students, and the variance of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses that are at the graduate level, and excluding the Biology department. Also, for each such department, show the total number of graduate-level subjects offered by that department. Present the results ordered by subject title and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_TERM_CODE, icte.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: From the top 10 Mathematics (Course 18) subjects offered in the term '2005FA' with the highest number of enrolled students, display each subject's title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, the course level, the number of unique degree-granting courses at that level in Mathematics with more than 10 enrolled students, and the minimum total units among those courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON c.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.COURSE = tso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = c.COURSE_LEVEL WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title, total units, department full name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each matching course material detail, provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, the course number description, the offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key. The results should include the subject title, total units, department full name, window row number, material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students, in that order, for subjects and course materials where the subject title and department code match between the two datasets. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: How many subjects offered by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program in 2012 had more than 5 enrolled students and were offered by the Chemistry department? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_2012_subjects FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2012' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'

target_disjoint_workload.question: For subjects offered in 2011 with more than 10 enrolled students, how many had a corresponding TIP subject with more than 5 enrolled students? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2011FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_with_more_than_10_enrolled FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2011FA' AND so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the Chemistry department, list the department name, the total number of reserved library materials for courses in the Engineering or Science schools (only for Chemistry and only for courses that have materials, with a total reserved materials count greater than 10), and for each subject offered by Chemistry that has course materials, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH DeptReservedMaterials AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10), ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT drm.department_name, drm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedMaterials AS drm JOIN ChemistrySubjects AS cs ON drm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY drm.total_reserved_materials DESC, cs.max_enrolled_students DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5) that has course materials, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key. Additionally, for the department offering each subject, include the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7). Present the results ordered by the maximum number of enrolled students (descending), then by enrolled students variance (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH chem_subjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM chem_subjects AS c LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.max_enrolled_students DESC, d.enrolled_students_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5) that has course materials, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key. Additionally, for the Chemistry department, include the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, subjects with a non-null subject code description, and excluding the Biology department (Course 7). Present the results with the columns in the following order: subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, maximum number of enrolled students, department name, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM ChemistrySubjects AS cs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each subject offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5) that has course materials, provide the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key, along with the minimum academic year and average total units for the corresponding academic term in the Mathematics department, where the academic year is between 2000 and 2020 or the total units are at least 6, and the total units are between 1 and 12. The results should be listed in order by term code and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_num_enrolled_students, m.min_academic_year, m.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS c JOIN MathTermStats AS m ON c.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.TERM_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each room with an access level of 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the highest floor within each space usage group. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, MAX(FLOOR) AS highest_floor FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE

target_disjoint_workload.question: From the top 10 space usage types with the highest number of rooms at access level 1, display each space usage type, the total number of such rooms, the average floor for that space usage, the organization name most frequently associated with that space usage, and the count of rooms for that organization within the space usage. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT icte.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(icte.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Room_Count, AVG(icte.FLOOR) AS Avg_Floor, org_stats.Top_Organization_Name, org_stats.Org_Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT icte2.SPACE_USAGE, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Top_Organization_Name, COUNT(icte2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Org_Room_Count, @rank := CASE WHEN @current_usage = icte2.SPACE_USAGE THEN @rank + 1 ELSE 1 END AS `Rank`, @current_usage := icte2.SPACE_USAGE FROM (SELECT SPACE_USAGE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM FROM inner_cte) AS icte2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_usage := '') AS vars GROUP BY icte2.SPACE_USAGE, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte2.SPACE_USAGE, Org_Room_Count DESC) AS org_stats ON icte.SPACE_USAGE = org_stats.SPACE_USAGE AND org_stats.`Rank` = 1 GROUP BY icte.SPACE_USAGE, org_stats.Top_Organization_Name, org_stats.Org_Room_Count ORDER BY Room_Count DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each room with an access level of 1, provide the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor, the average access level, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of access levels of rooms assigned to that organization (considering only rooms on floor 2 or higher), ordered by organization name and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH OrgAccessStats AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC), RoomDetails AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT rd.BUILDING_ROOM, rd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, rd.FLOOR, rd.SPACE_USAGE, rd.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rd.window_column, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev FROM RoomDetails AS rd JOIN OrgAccessStats AS oas ON rd.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = oas.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY rd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rd.BUILDING_ROOM

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each building, what is the building name, the average, range, and variance of the room areas for rooms in that building where the building type is 'ACADEMIC' and the room area is greater than 40, and for each such room with an access level of 1, what are the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH building_room_stats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC), room_access_info AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.avg_room_area, brs.room_area_range, brs.room_area_variance, rai.BUILDING_ROOM, rai.BUILDING_COMPONENT, rai.FLOOR, rai.SPACE_USAGE, rai.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rai.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rai.window_column FROM building_room_stats AS brs JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON brs.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN room_access_info AS rai ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = rai.BUILDING_ROOM

target_disjoint_workload.question: For rooms located on floor 2 with access level 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, access level, organization name, organization, department name, department code, and the minimum access level over each department code group, along with the department long name, department hierarchy level 3 name, the number of unique facility organization keys, and the minimum organization unit ID for each department where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH RoomsOnFloor2Access1 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t0.FLOOR, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_access_level, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 AND t0.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), DeptHierarchyAgg AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS f JOIN `MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY` AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.BUILDING_COMPONENT, r.FLOOR, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, r.ACCESS_LEVEL, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.ORGANIZATION, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, r.min_access_level, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.org_count, d.min_org_unit_id FROM RoomsOnFloor2Access1 AS r LEFT JOIN DeptHierarchyAgg AS d ON r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = d.min_org_unit_id ORDER BY r.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and for rooms on floor 2 that are associated via space unit code, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the building room, space usage, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, ordered by organization name and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each room with access level 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor, the building name, the average, range, and variance of the room areas for rooms in that building where the building type is 'ACADEMIC' and the room area is greater than 40, and calculate the normalized floor to area ratio (average floor divided by average room area in that building), ordered by the normalized floor to area ratio in descending order.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC), RoomAccessStats AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ras.FLOOR, ras.SPACE_USAGE, ras.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.window_column, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.avg_room_area, brs.room_area_range, brs.room_area_variance, ROUND(ras.window_column / NULLIF(brs.avg_room_area, 0), 2) AS normalized_floor_to_area FROM RoomAccessStats AS ras JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON ras.BUILDING_ROOM = fr.BUILDING_ROOM JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs ON fb.BUILDING_NAME = brs.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY normalized_floor_to_area DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each academic building with at least one room area greater than 40, list the building name, the average room area, the range of room areas, and the variance of room areas for those rooms, along with each room in that building that has access level 1, showing the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH BuildingRoomAreaStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC), RoomAccessStats AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bras.BUILDING_NAME, bras.avg_room_area, bras.room_area_range, bras.room_area_variance, ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ras.FLOOR, ras.SPACE_USAGE, ras.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.window_column FROM BuildingRoomAreaStats AS bras JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON bras.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessStats AS ras ON ras.BUILDING_ROOM = r.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY bras.room_area_range DESC, ras.FLOOR

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each building that has more than five rooms, show the building number and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, and for each room in that building with an access level of 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH BuildingAreaStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC), RoomAccessLevel1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bal.BUILDING_NUMBER, bal.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column FROM BuildingAreaStddev AS bal JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON bal.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessLevel1 AS ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY bal.area_stddev DESC, ral1.FLOOR

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT cr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, cr.DESCRIPTION, cr.SPACE_UNIT, cr.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, cr.org_window_column, cr.BUILDING_ROOM, cr.SPACE_USAGE, cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, cr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cr.room_window_column, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM CombinedResults AS cr JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH BuildingAreaStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC), RoomAccessLevel1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bal.BUILDING_NUMBER, bal.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column, fr.AREA, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingAreaStddev AS bal JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON bal.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessLevel1 AS ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM), BuildingAvgArea AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.area_stddev, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.BUILDING_COMPONENT, i.FLOOR, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN BuildingAvgArea AS baa ON i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = baa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE i.AREA > baa.avg_area ORDER BY i.area_stddev DESC, i.FLOOR

cases.title: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the space unit codes for
cases.question: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department, considering only space units with a code greater than 0? Also, for each department, indicate whether the geometric mean is 'HIGH' (at least 20% greater than the average geometric mean across all departments), 'LOW' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Provide the department name, the geometric mean, the overall average geometric mean, and the category. Do not return any rounded answers.

cases.question: For each department that both grants degrees (excluding Biology, Course 7, and only including those with non-null subject code descriptions) and is named 'Mathematics', list the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students), and calculate the ratio of the subject enrollment variance to the course enrollment variance rounded to two decimal places, ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.

Do not return any rounded answers.

cases.question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree-granting and not from the Mathematics department, what is the maximum CIP program code among all its associated subject codes, what is the department name of the course, what are the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology department and only including departments that grant degrees), and what is the total number of subjects offered by that department in 2022?
